00006:   return String(lottery || "PT_RIO").trim().toUpperCase();

00009: function normalizeGrupo(v) {
00010:   const n = Number(v);
00011:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 25 ? n : null;
00012: }
00013: 
00014: function normalizePosition(v) {
00015:   const n = Number(v);
00016:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 10 ? n : null;
00017: }

00019: async function fetchPrizesForDrawRef(drawRef) {
00020:   const snap = await drawRef.collection("prizes").get();
00021: 
00022:   return snap.docs
00023:     .map((doc) => {
00024:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00025:       return {
00026:         id: doc.id,
00027:         ...data,
00028:         grupo: normalizeGrupo(data.grupo),
00029:         position: normalizePosition(data.position),
00030:       };
00031:     })
00032:     .filter((p) => p.grupo && p.position);
00033: }
00034: 
00035: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, mapper) {
00036:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00037:   const out = new Array(arr.length);
00038:   let index = 0;
00039: 
00040:   async function worker() {
00041:     while (index < arr.length) {
00042:       const i = index++;
00043:       out[i] = await mapper(arr[i], i);
00044:     }
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   await Promise.all(
00048:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker)
00049:   );
00050: 
00051:   return out;
00052: }

00004:  * Modelo central do Score Engine.

00007: 
00008: function normalizeLotteryKey(value) {
00009:   const s = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00010:   if (s === "RJ" || s === "RIO" || s === "PT-RIO" || s === "PT_RIO") return "PT_RIO";
00011:   if (s === "FED" || s === "FEDERAL") return "FEDERAL";
00012:   return s || "PT_RIO";
00013: }
00014: 
00015: function pad2(n) {
00016:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00017: }
00018: 
00019: function makePredictionRunId({ lotteryKey, date, closeHour, source = "manual" }) {
00020:   const lk = normalizeLotteryKey(lotteryKey);
00021:   const d = String(date || "").trim();
00022:   const h = String(closeHour || "").trim().replace(":", "");
00023:   const src = String(source || "manual").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, "_");
00024: 
00025:   return `${lk}__${d}__${h || "NA"}__${src}`;
00026: }
00027: 
00028: function buildPredictionRun({
00029:   lotteryKey,
00030:   date,
00031:   closeHour,
00032:   source = "manual",
00033:   algorithm = "score_engine_v1",
00034:   status = "generated",
00035:   metadata = {},
00036: } = {}) {
00037:   const lk = normalizeLotteryKey(lotteryKey);
00038: 
00039:   return {
00040:     id: makePredictionRunId({ lotteryKey: lk, date, closeHour, source }),
00041:     lottery_key: lk,
00042:     date: String(date || "").trim(),
00043:     ymd: String(date || "").trim(),
00044:     close_hour: String(closeHour || "").trim() || null,
00045:     source,
00046:     algorithm,
00047:     status,
00048:     metadata,
00049:     createdAt: null,
00050:     updatedAt: null,
00051:   };
00052: }
00053: 
00054: function buildPrediction({
00055:   runId,
00056:   type = "grupo",
00057:   grupo,
00058:   animal,
00059:   dezena = null,
00060:   centena = null,
00061:   milhar = null,
00062:   score = 0,
00063:   confidence = 0,
00064:   reasons = [],
00065:   signals = {},
00066: } = {}) {
00067:   const g = Number(grupo);
00068:   const grupo2 = Number.isFinite(g) ? pad2(g) : null;
00069: 
00070:   return {
00071:     runId,
00072:     type,
00073:     grupo: grupo2,
00074:     animal: animal || null,
00075:     dezena,
00076:     centena,
00077:     milhar,
00078:     score: Number(score) || 0,
00079:     confidence: Number(confidence) || 0,
00080:     reasons: Array.isArray(reasons) ? reasons : [],
00081:     signals: signals && typeof signals === "object" ? signals : {},
00082:     status: "pending",
00083:     result: null,
00084:     createdAt: null,
00085:     updatedAt: null,
00086:   };
00087: }

00025: function getExpectedHours(lottery, date, hasFederal) {
00026:   if (lottery !== "PT_RIO") return [];
00027: 
00028:   const dt = new Date(`${date}T12:00:00`);
00029:   const dow = dt.getDay(); // 0 = domingo
00030: 
00031:   // Domingo: só 09, 11, 14, 16
00032:   if (dow === 0) {
00033:     return ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00"];
00034:   }
00035: 
00036:   // Base fixa todos os outros dias
00037:   const expected = ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00"];
00038: 
00039:   // 21h existe fora domingo
00040:   expected.push("21:00");
00041: 
00042:   // 18h só se NÃO tiver Federal no dia
00043:   if (!hasFederal) {

00076:   return {
00077:     ok: missing.length === 0 && extra.length === 0,

00088: function isISODate(s) {
00089:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00090:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00091: 
00092:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00093:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00094: 
00095:   return (
00096:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00097:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00098:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00099:   );
00100: }

00102: function isHHMM(s) {
00103:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00104:   const m = str.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00105:   if (!m) return false;
00106: 
00107:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00108:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00109: 
00110:   return hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59;
00111: }

00113: function normalizeHHMM(value) {

00116: 
00117:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;

00123:     return "";
00124:   }
00125: 
00126:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00127:   if (m2) {

00130:     return "";
00131:   }
00132:

00134:   if (m3) {

00138:       return `${String(hh).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(mm).padStart(2, "0")}`;

00195:     const b = Math.max(1, Number(m[2]));

00212: }

00231: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00232:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00233:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00234:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00235:   let idx = 0;
00236: 
00237:   async function worker() {
00238:     while (true) {
00239:       const current = idx;
00240:       idx += 1;
00241:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00242:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00243:     }
00244:   }
00245: 
00246:   await Promise.all(
00247:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00248:   );
00249: 
00250:   return results;
00251: }

00253: async function loadPrizesForDraws(db, drawsWindow, includePrizes, positionsInfo) {
00254:   if (!includePrizes) return drawsWindow;
00255: 
00256:   const posArr =
00257:     positionsInfo && Array.isArray(positionsInfo.positions)
00258:       ? positionsInfo.positions
00259:       : null;
00260: 
00261:   const posSet =
00262:     posArr && posArr.length
00263:       ? new Set(posArr.map((n) => Number(n)))
00264:       : null;
00265: 
00266:   const draws = await mapWithConcurrency(drawsWindow, 6, async (d) => {
00267:     let q = db
00268:       .collection("draws")
00269:       .doc(d.id)
00270:       .collection("prizes")
00271:       .orderBy("position", "asc");
00272: 
00273:     if (positionsInfo && positionsInfo.maxPos && posArr) {
00274:       const maxPos = Number(positionsInfo.maxPos) || null;
00275:       const contiguousFrom1 =
00276:         maxPos &&
00277:         posArr.length === maxPos &&
00278:         Number(posArr[0]) === 1 &&
00279:         Number(posArr[posArr.length - 1]) === maxPos;
00280: 
00281:       if (contiguousFrom1) q = q.limit(maxPos);
00282:     }
00283: 
00284:     const prizesSnap = await q.get();

00286:     const prizes = posSet

00288:       : rows;
00289:

00291:   });
00292:

00231: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00232:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00233:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00234:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00235:   let idx = 0;
00236: 
00237:   async function worker() {
00238:     while (true) {
00239:       const current = idx;
00240:       idx += 1;
00241:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00242:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00243:     }
00244:   }
00245: 
00246:   await Promise.all(
00247:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00248:   );
00249: 
00250:   return results;
00251: }

00253: async function loadPrizesForDraws(db, drawsWindow, includePrizes, positionsInfo) {
00254:   if (!includePrizes) return drawsWindow;
00255: 
00256:   const posArr =
00257:     positionsInfo && Array.isArray(positionsInfo.positions)
00258:       ? positionsInfo.positions
00259:       : null;
00260: 
00261:   const posSet =
00262:     posArr && posArr.length
00263:       ? new Set(posArr.map((n) => Number(n)))
00264:       : null;
00265: 
00266:   const draws = await mapWithConcurrency(drawsWindow, 6, async (d) => {
00267:     let q = db
00268:       .collection("draws")
00269:       .doc(d.id)
00270:       .collection("prizes")
00271:       .orderBy("position", "asc");
00272: 
00273:     if (positionsInfo && positionsInfo.maxPos && posArr) {
00274:       const maxPos = Number(positionsInfo.maxPos) || null;
00275:       const contiguousFrom1 =
00276:         maxPos &&
00277:         posArr.length === maxPos &&
00278:         Number(posArr[0]) === 1 &&
00279:         Number(posArr[posArr.length - 1]) === maxPos;
00280: 
00281:       if (contiguousFrom1) q = q.limit(maxPos);
00282:     }
00283: 
00284:     const prizesSnap = await q.get();
00285:     const rows = prizesSnap.docs.map((p) => p.data());
00286:     const prizes = posSet
00287:       ? rows.filter((r) => posSet.has(Number(r.position)))
00288:       : rows;
00289: 
00290:     return { ...d, prizes };
00291:   });
00292: 
00293:   return draws;
00294: }

00382:     }
00383: 
00384:     if (hasFrom && hasTo && ymd >= from0 && ymd <= to0) return r;
00385:   }
00386:   return null;

00501: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00502:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00503:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00504:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00505:   let idx = 0;
00506: 
00507:   async function worker() {
00508:     while (true) {
00509:       const current = idx;
00510:       idx += 1;
00511:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00512:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00513:     }
00514:   }
00515: 
00516:   await Promise.all(
00517:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00518:   );
00519:   return results;
00520: }

00501: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00502:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00503:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00504:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00505:   let idx = 0;
00506: 
00507:   async function worker() {
00508:     while (true) {
00509:       const current = idx;
00510:       idx += 1;
00511:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00512:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00513:     }
00514:   }
00515: 
00516:   await Promise.all(
00517:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00518:   );
00519:   return results;
00520: }

00532:   if (blocked) status = blockedReason === "future_date" ? "future" : "blocked";
00533:   else if (isToday && missing > 0) status = "pending";
00534:   else if (expected > 0 && missing === 0) status = "complete";
00535:   else if (found > 0 && missing > 0) status = "partial";
00536:   else if (expected > 0 && found === 0) status = "empty";
00537: 
00538:   return {
00539:     status,
00540:     expected,
00541:     found,
00542:     missing,
00543:     completionPct: Number(slotsSummary?.completionPct ?? 0),
00544:   };
00545: }

00160:       if (y && isISODate(y)) {
00161:         return { ymd: y, docId: doc.id, raw: v };

00174:     source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
00175:     minDocId: minPick.docId,
00176:     maxDocId: maxPick.docId,
00177:     minRaw: minPick.raw ?? null,
00178:     maxRaw: maxPick.raw ?? null,
00179:   };
00180: }
00181: 
00182: async function fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lotteryKey, edgeLimit) {
00183:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00184:   const base = db.collection("draws").where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey);
00185: 
00186:   const ascSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limit(edgeLimit).get();
00187:   const descSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limitToLast(edgeLimit).get();
00188: 
00189:   const merged = [...ascSnap.docs, ...descSnap.docs];
00190:   const { minYmd, maxYmd } = pickMinMaxFromDocs(merged);
00191: 
00192:   return {
00193:     ok: !!(minYmd && maxYmd),
00194:     minYmd: minYmd || null,
00195:     maxYmd: maxYmd || null,
00196:     source: `fallback_edges_docId(limit=${edgeLimit})`,
00197:     sampleCount: merged.length,
00198:     firstDocId: ascSnap.docs[0]?.id || null,
00199:     lastDocId: descSnap.docs[descSnap.docs.length - 1]?.id || null,
00200:   };
00201: }

00203: async function main() {
00204:   const lotteryKey =
00205:     String(process.argv[2] || "PT_RIO").trim().toUpperCase() || "PT_RIO";
00206: 
00207:   const edgeArg = Number(process.argv[3]);
00208:   const edgeLimit = Number.isFinite(edgeArg) ? Math.max(200, edgeArg) : 800;
00209: 
00210:   const scanArg = Number(process.argv[4]);
00211:   const scanLimit = Number.isFinite(scanArg) ? Math.max(10, scanArg) : 50;
00212: 
00213:   const db = getDb();
00214: 
00215:   let result = null;
00216:   const warns = [];
00217: 
00218:   // 1) tenta por ymd
00219:   try {
00220:     result = await tryBoundsByField(db, lotteryKey, "ymd", scanLimit);
00221:   } catch (e) {
00222:     warns.push(e);
00223:   }
00224: 
00225:   // 2) tenta por date (normalizado SP)
00226:   if (!result || !result.ok) {
00227:     try {
00228:       const r2 = await tryBoundsByField(db, lotteryKey, "date", scanLimit);
00229:       if (r2?.minYmd && r2?.maxYmd) {
00230:         result = { ...r2, source: r2.source + " (normalized@SP)" };
00231:       } else {
00232:         result = r2;
00233:       }
00234:     } catch (e) {
00235:       warns.push(e);
00236:     }
00237:   }
00238: 
00239:   // 3) fallback por docId edges
00240:   if (!result || !result.ok) {
00241:     result = await fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lotteryKey, edgeLimit);
00242:   }
00243: 
00244:   console.log("==================================");
00245:   console.log(`[AUDIT] lottery_key=${lotteryKey}`);
00246:   console.log(`source: ${result?.source || "unknown"}`);
00247: 
00248:   const hadIndexWarn = warns.some((w) => isIndexError(w));
00249:   if (hadIndexWarn) {
00250:     console.log(
00251:       "note: faltou índice composto em pelo menos uma tentativa (ok, caiu em alternativa/fallback)."
00252:     );
00253:   }
00254:   if (result?.source?.includes("fallback")) {
00255:     console.log("note: bounds obtidos por fallback (amostragem; pode não ser o min/max absoluto).");
00256:   }
00257: 
00258:   console.log(`minYmd: ${result?.minYmd || "N/A"}`);
00259:   console.log(`maxYmd: ${result?.maxYmd || "N/A"}`);
00260: 
00261:   if (result?.minDocId || result?.maxDocId) {
00262:     console.log(`minDocId: ${result?.minDocId || "N/A"}`);
00263:     console.log(`maxDocId: ${result?.maxDocId || "N/A"}`);
00264:   }
00265: 
00266:   if (result?.sampleCount) console.log(`sampleCount: ${result.sampleCount}`);
00267:   if (result?.firstDocId || result?.lastDocId) {

00078: function normalizeHourLike(v) {
00079:   if (v == null) return null;
00080:   const s = String(v).trim();
00081:   if (!s) return null;
00082:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:[:hH]?(\d{2}))?/);
00083:   if (!m) return s;
00084:   const hh = String(m[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00085:   const mm = String(m[2] || "00").padStart(2, "0");
00086:   return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00087: }

00089: function isIndexError(err) {
00090:   const msg = String(err?.message || "").toLowerCase();
00091:   const code = String(err?.code || "").toLowerCase();
00092:   return (
00093:     code.includes("failed-precondition") ||
00094:     msg.includes("failed_precondition") ||
00095:     (msg.includes("index") && msg.includes("create")) ||
00096:     (msg.includes("requires") && msg.includes("index"))
00097:   );
00098: }

00078: function normalizeHourLike(v) {
00079:   if (v == null) return null;
00080:   const s = String(v).trim();
00081:   if (!s) return null;
00082:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:[:hH]?(\d{2}))?/);
00083:   if (!m) return s;
00084:   const hh = String(m[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00085:   const mm = String(m[2] || "00").padStart(2, "0");
00086:   return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00087: }

00091:   const code = String(err?.code || "").toLowerCase();

00094:     msg.includes("failed_precondition") ||
00095:     (msg.includes("index") && msg.includes("create")) ||
00096:     (msg.includes("requires") && msg.includes("index"))
00097:   );
00098: }

00155: async function fetchRowsForRange(db, { lotteryKey, fromYmd, toYmd, pageSize = 2000, maxPages = 80 } = {}) {
00156:   const lot = lotteryKey ? String(lotteryKey).trim().toUpperCase() : null;
00157: 
00158:   // 1) tentativa indexada (aceita range parcial)
00159:   try {
00160:     let q = db.collection("draws");
00161:     if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00162:     if (fromYmd) q = q.where("ymd", ">=", fromYmd);
00163:     if (toYmd) q = q.where("ymd", "<=", toYmd);
00164: 
00165:     const snap = await q.get();
00166:     const rows = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...(d.data() || {}) }));
00167:     return { rows, source: "query: where(lottery_key)+where(ymd>=/<=)", usedFallback: false };
00168:   } catch (e) {
00169:     if (!isIndexError(e)) throw e;
00170:   }
00171: 
00172:   // 2) fallback sem índice: pagina por docId e filtra em memória
00173:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00174:   let q = db.collection("draws");
00175:   if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00176:   q = q.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc");
00177: 
00178:   let last = null;
00179:   const out = [];
00180: 
00181:   for (let page = 1; page <= maxPages; page++) {
00182:     let qq = q.limit(pageSize);
00183:     if (last) qq = qq.startAfter(last);
00184: 
00185:     const snap = await qq.get();
00186:     if (snap.empty) break;
00187: 
00188:     for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00189:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00190:       const ymd = normalizeToYMD(data.ymd ?? data.date ?? data.draw_date ?? data.close_date ?? data.dt ?? data.data);
00191:       if (!ymd || !isISODateStrict(ymd)) continue;
00192:       if (fromYmd && ymd < fromYmd) continue;
00193:       if (toYmd && ymd > toYmd) continue;
00194:       out.push({ id: doc.id, ...data });
00195:     }
00196: 
00197:     last = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
00198:   }
00199: 
00200:   return { rows: out, source: "fallback: paginate by docId + filter(ymd)", usedFallback: true };
00201: }

00206:   return def;

00413: // =====================
00414: function loadNoDrawOrNull(lotteryKey, noDrawFileArg) {
00415:   const noDrawFile =
00416:     String(noDrawFileArg || "").trim() ||
00417:     path.join(DEFAULT_NO_DRAW_DIR, `${lotteryKey}.json`);
00418: 
00419:   if (!fs.existsSync(noDrawFile)) return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00420: 
00421:   const noDraw = safeReadJson(noDrawFile, null);
00422:   if (!noDraw || typeof noDraw !== "object") return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00423: 
00424:   const lk = String(noDraw.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00425:   if (lk && lk !== lotteryKey) return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00426: 
00427:   const daysArr = Array.isArray(noDraw.days) ? noDraw.days : [];
00428:   const set = new Set();
00429:   for (const d of daysArr) {
00430:     const ymd = String(d || "").trim();
00431:     if (isISODate(ymd)) set.add(ymd);
00432:   }
00433: 
00434:   noDraw.lotteryKey = lotteryKey;
00435:   noDraw.days = Array.from(set).sort();
00436: 
00437:   return { noDraw: { daysSet: set, days: noDraw.days }, noDrawFile };
00438: }
00439: 
00440: function noDrawSetHas(noDraw, ymd) {
00441:   if (!noDraw || !noDraw.daysSet) return false;
00442:   return noDraw.daysSet.has(ymd);
00443: }

00445: // =====================
00446: // Time helpers (local)
00447: // =====================
00448: function getLocalYmd(d) {
00449:   const x = d ? new Date(d) : new Date();
00450:   return `${x.getFullYear()}-${pad2(x.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(x.getDate())}`;
00451: }
00452: function getLocalNowMinutes(d) {
00453:   const x = d ? new Date(d) : new Date();
00454:   return x.getHours() * 60 + x.getMinutes();
00455: }
00456: function hourToMinutes(h) {
00457:   const n = Number(h);
00458:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n * 60 : NaN;
00459: }
00460: 
00461: // ✅ NOVO: parse "HH:mm" -> minutos
00462: function parseHmToMinutes(hm) {
00463:   const s = String(hm || "").trim();
00464:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
00465:   if (!m) return null;
00466:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00467:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00468:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;
00469:   if (hh < 0 || hh > 23 || mm < 0 || mm > 59) return null;
00470:   return hh * 60 + mm;
00471: }

00005: const LOTTERY = "PT_RIO";
00006: const START = "2022-06-07";

00008: const EXPECTED = ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00", "18:00", "21:00"];
00009: 
00010: function addDays(ymd, n) {
00011:   const d = new Date(ymd + "T00:00:00Z");
00012:   d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n);
00013:   return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
00014: }
00015: 
00016: function normHour(v) {
00017:   const s = String(v || "").trim();
00018:   const m = s.match(/(\d{1,2})[:hH]?(\d{2})?/);
00019:   if (!m) return "";
00020:   return `${String(Number(m[1])).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00021: }
00022: 
00023: (async () => {
00024:   const db = getDb();
00025: 
00026:   console.log("Buscando draws no Firestore...");
00027: 
00028:   const snap = await db
00029:     .collection("draws")
00030:     .where("lottery_key", "==", LOTTERY)
00031:     .get();
00032: 
00033:   const byKey = new Map();
00034:   const duplicates = [];
00035: 
00036:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00037:     const d = doc.data();
00038:     const ymd = d.ymd || d.date;
00039:     const hour = normHour(d.close_hour || d.hour);
00040:     if (!ymd || !hour) continue;
00041: 
00042:     const key = `${ymd}|${hour}`;
00043:     if (!byKey.has(key)) byKey.set(key, []);
00044:     byKey.get(key).push({ id: doc.id, ymd, hour });
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   const missing = [];
00048: 
00049:   for (let ymd = START; ymd <= END; ymd = addDays(ymd, 1)) {
00050:     for (const hour of EXPECTED) {
00051:       const rows = byKey.get(`${ymd}|${hour}`) || [];
00052:       if (!rows.length) missing.push({ ymd, hour });
00053:       if (rows.length > 1) duplicates.push({ ymd, hour, count: rows.length, ids: rows.map(x => x.id) });
00054:     }
00055:   }
00056: 
00057:   const report = {
00058:     lottery: LOTTERY,
00059:     start: START,
00060:     end: END,
00061:     totalDocs: snap.size,
00062:     expectedPerDay: EXPECTED,
00063:     missingCount: missing.length,
00064:     duplicateCount: duplicates.length,
00065:     missing,
00066:     duplicates
00067:   };
00068: 
00069:   const outJson = path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "logs", `auditFast-${LOTTERY}-${START}_to_${END}.json`);
00070:   fs.writeFileSync(outJson, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2), "utf8");
00071: 
00072:   const outCsv = path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "logs", `auditFast-${LOTTERY}-${START}_to_${END}.csv`);
00073:   fs.writeFileSync(
00074:     outCsv,
00075:     "type,ymd,hour,count,ids\n" +
00076:       missing.map(x => `MISSING,${x.ymd},${x.hour},,`).join("\n") +
00077:       "\n" +
00078:       duplicates.map(x => `DUPLICATE,${x.ymd},${x.hour},${x.count},"${x.ids.join(" | ")}"`).join("\n"),
00079:     "utf8"
00080:   );
00081: 
00082:   console.log("\n========== AUDITORIA RÁPIDA ==========");

--- CONTEXTO LINHA 51 ---
00011:   const d = new Date(ymd + "T00:00:00Z");
00012:   d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n);
00013:   return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
00014: }
00015: 
00016: function normHour(v) {
00017:   const s = String(v || "").trim();
00018:   const m = s.match(/(\d{1,2})[:hH]?(\d{2})?/);
00019:   if (!m) return "";
00020:   return `${String(Number(m[1])).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00021: }
00022: 
00023: (async () => {
00024:   const db = getDb();
00025: 
00026:   console.log("Buscando draws no Firestore...");
00027: 
00028:   const snap = await db
00029:     .collection("draws")
00030:     .where("lottery_key", "==", LOTTERY)
00031:     .get();
00032: 
00033:   const byKey = new Map();
00034:   const duplicates = [];
00035: 
00036:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00037:     const d = doc.data();
00038:     const ymd = d.ymd || d.date;
00039:     const hour = normHour(d.close_hour || d.hour);
00040:     if (!ymd || !hour) continue;
00041: 
00042:     const key = `${ymd}|${hour}`;
00043:     if (!byKey.has(key)) byKey.set(key, []);
00044:     byKey.get(key).push({ id: doc.id, ymd, hour });
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   const missing = [];
00048: 
00049:   for (let ymd = START; ymd <= END; ymd = addDays(ymd, 1)) {
00050:     for (const hour of EXPECTED) {
00051:       const rows = byKey.get(`${ymd}|${hour}`) || [];
00052:       if (!rows.length) missing.push({ ymd, hour });
00053:       if (rows.length > 1) duplicates.push({ ymd, hour, count: rows.length, ids: rows.map(x => x.id) });
00054:     }
00055:   }
00056: 
00057:   const report = {
00058:     lottery: LOTTERY,
00059:     start: START,
00060:     end: END,
00061:     totalDocs: snap.size,
00062:     expectedPerDay: EXPECTED,
00063:     missingCount: missing.length,
00064:     duplicateCount: duplicates.length,
00065:     missing,
00066:     duplicates
00067:   };
00068: 
00069:   const outJson = path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "logs", `auditFast-${LOTTERY}-${START}_to_${END}.json`);
00070:   fs.writeFileSync(outJson, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2), "utf8");
00071: 
00072:   const outCsv = path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "logs", `auditFast-${LOTTERY}-${START}_to_${END}.csv`);
00073:   fs.writeFileSync(
00074:     outCsv,
00075:     "type,ymd,hour,count,ids\n" +
00076:       missing.map(x => `MISSING,${x.ymd},${x.hour},,`).join("\n") +
00077:       "\n" +
00078:       duplicates.map(x => `DUPLICATE,${x.ymd},${x.hour},${x.count},"${x.ids.join(" | ")}"`).join("\n"),
00079:     "utf8"
00080:   );
00081: 
00082:   console.log("\n========== AUDITORIA RÁPIDA ==========");
00083:   console.log("Loteria:", LOTTERY);
00084:   console.log("Docs encontrados:", snap.size);
00085:   console.log("Furos:", missing.length);
00086:   console.log("Duplicados:", duplicates.length);
00087:   console.log("JSON:", outJson);
00088:   console.log("CSV:", outCsv);
00089: 
00090:   console.log("\n--- ÚLTIMOS 80 FUROS ---");
00091:   console.table(missing.slice(-80));
00092: 
00093:   console.log("\n--- ÚLTIMOS 20 DUPLICADOS ---");
00094:   console.table(duplicates.slice(-20));
00095: 
00096:   process.exit(0);

00009: }
00010: 
00011: function addDays(d, n) {
00012:   const x = new Date(d);
00013:   x.setDate(x.getDate() + n);
00014:   return x;
00015: }
00016: 
00017: (async () => {
00018:   const db = getDb();
00019: 
00020:   const start = "2022-06-08";
00021:   const end = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
00022: 
00023:   const noDraw = require("../data/no_draw_days/FEDERAL.json");
00024:   const noDrawSet = new Set(Array.isArray(noDraw.days) ? noDraw.days : []);
00025: 
00026:   const snap = await db
00027:     .collection("draws")
00028:     .where("lottery_key", "==", "FEDERAL")
00029:     .orderBy("ymd", "asc")
00030:     .get();
00031:

00033:   const prizeIssues = [];

00037:     const day = data.ymd || data.date;
00038: 
00039:     if (!byDay.has(day)) byDay.set(day, []);
00040:     byDay.get(day).push(doc.id);
00041: 
00042:     const prizes = await doc.ref.collection("prizes").get();
00043:     if (prizes.size !== Number(data.prizesCount || 7)) {
00044:       prizeIssues.push({
00045:         drawId: doc.id,
00046:         ymd: day,
00047:         declared: data.prizesCount,
00048:         actualPrizes: prizes.size,
00049:       });
00050:     }

00058:     const dow = d.getDay();
00059: 
00060:     // Federal: quarta(3) e sábado(6), exceto dias cadastrados sem sorteio
00061:     if ((dow === 3 || dow === 6) && !noDrawSet.has(day)) {
00062:       expected.push(day);
00063:     }
00064: 
00065:     d = addDays(d, 1);
00066:   }
00067:

00069:   const missingDays = expected.filter((day) => !byDay.has(day));

00071:   const duplicateDays = actualDays
00072:     .filter((day) => byDay.get(day).length > 1)

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }
00037: 
00038: function normalizeCloseHourForFederal(value) {
00039:   const raw = normalizeHHMM(value);
00040:   if (!raw) return "";
00041:   return `${raw.slice(0, 2)}:00`;
00042: }
00043: 
00044: function normMilhar(v) {
00045:   const s = String(v ?? "").replace(/\D/g, "").trim();
00046:   if (!s) return "";
00047:   return s.slice(-4).padStart(4, "0");
00048: }
00049: 
00050: function extractKingPrizes(draw) {
00051:   const out = {};
00052:   for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
00053:     const v = normMilhar(draw?.[`prize_${i}`]);
00054:     if (v) out[i] = v;
00055:   }
00056:   return out;
00057: }
00058: 
00059: async function readFirestoreByDate(date) {
00060:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00061: 
00062:   const bySlot = new Map();
00063: 
00064:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00065:     const d = doc.data() || {};
00066:     const lk = String(d.lottery_key || d.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00067:     if (lk !== LOTTERY_KEY) continue;
00068: 
00069:     const slot = normalizeCloseHourForFederal(d.close_hour || d.close || d.hour || "");
00070:     if (!slot) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const pSnap = await doc.ref.collection("prizes").get();
00073:     const prizes = {};
00074: 
00075:     pSnap.forEach((pdoc) => {
00076:       const p = pdoc.data() || {};
00077:       const pos = Number(p.position || String(pdoc.id || "").replace(/\D/g, ""));
00078:       const milhar = normMilhar(p.milhar || p.value || p.raw);
00079:       if (Number.isFinite(pos) && pos >= 1 && pos <= 7 && milhar) {
00080:         prizes[pos] = milhar;
00081:       }
00082:     });
00083: 
00084:     const row = {
00085:       id: doc.id,
00086:       slot,
00087:       prizes,
00088:       prizeCount: Object.keys(prizes).length,
00089:     };
00090: 
00091:     if (!bySlot.has(slot)) bySlot.set(slot, []);
00092:     bySlot.get(slot).push(row);
00093:   }
00094: 
00095:   return bySlot;
00096: }
00097: 
00098: function pickBestDoc(arr) {
00099:   const list = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.slice() : [];
00100:   list.sort((a, b) => Number(b.prizeCount || 0) - Number(a.prizeCount || 0));
00101:   return list[0] || null;
00102: }
00103: 
00104: async function auditDate(date) {
00105:   const payload = await fetchKingResults({ date, lotteryKey: LOTTERY_KEY });
00106:   const sourceDraws = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [];
00107: 
00108:   const sourceBySlot = new Map();
00109: 
00110:   for (const draw of sourceDraws) {
00111:     const slot = normalizeCloseHourForFederal(draw?.close_hour || "");
00112:     if (!slot) continue;
00113:     sourceBySlot.set(slot, {
00114:       slot,
00115:       prizes: extractKingPrizes(draw),
00116:     });
00117:   }
00118: 
00119:   const fsBySlot = await readFirestoreByDate(date);
00120: 
00121:   const allSlots = Array.from(
00122:     new Set([...sourceBySlot.keys(), ...fsBySlot.keys()])
00123:   ).sort();
00124: 
00125:   const problems = [];
00126: 
00127:   for (const slot of allSlots) {
00128:     const src = sourceBySlot.get(slot);
00129:     const docs = fsBySlot.get(slot) || [];
00130:     const fsDoc = pickBestDoc(docs);
00131: 
00132:     if (!src) {
00133:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "extra_firestore", firestoreDocs: docs.map(x => x.id) });
00134:       continue;
00135:     }
00136: 
00137:     if (!fsDoc) {
00138:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "missing_firestore" });
00139:       continue;
00140:     }

00074: function keyFor(row) {
00075:   const prizes = Array.isArray(row.prizes)
00076:     ? row.prizes
00077:     : Object.values(row.prizes || {});
00078: 
00079:   const normalized = prizes
00080:     .map((p) => String(p || "").padStart(4, "0"))
00081:     .join("|");
00082: 
00083:   return `${row.date}::${normalized}`;
00084: }

00087: function scoreDoc(d) {
00088:   let score = 0;
00089:   if (pickDate(d)) score += 10;
00090:   if (pickHour(d)) score += 5;
00091:   if (Array.isArray(d.prizes) && d.prizes.length) score += 50;
00092:   if (Array.isArray(d.results) && d.results.length) score += 30;
00093:   if (d.lotteryKey === "FEDERAL") score += 20;
00094:   if (d.source) score += 5;

00039:     if ((a?.[i] || "") !== (b?.[i] || "")) return false;

00044: async function readFederalFirestoreByDate(date) {
00045:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();

00068:     });
00069:   }
00070: 
00071:   rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.prizeCount || 0) - Number(a.prizeCount || 0));

00050:   const byContest = new Map();

00045: function isISODate(s) {
00046:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00047:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00048: 
00049:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00050:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00051: 
00052:   return (
00053:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00054:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00055:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00056:   );
00057: }

00059: function safeReadJson(filePath, fallback) {
00060:   try {
00061:     if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return fallback;
00062:     const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
00063:     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
00064:     return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? parsed : fallback;
00065:   } catch {
00066:     return fallback;
00067:   }
00068: }

00070: function normalizeHourList(arr) {
00071:   const out = [];
00072:   const seen = new Set();
00073: 
00074:   for (const v of Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []) {
00075:     const m = String(v ?? "").match(/\d{1,2}/);
00076:     if (!m) continue;
00077: 
00078:     const hh = pad2(Number(m[0]));
00079:     const n = Number(hh);
00080:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 23) continue;
00081: 
00082:     if (!seen.has(hh)) {
00083:       seen.add(hh);
00084:       out.push(hh);
00085:     }
00086:   }
00087: 
00088:   return out.sort();
00089: }

00091: function uniqSorted(arr) {
00092:   return Array.from(new Set(Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [])).sort();
00093: }

00095: function pickRangeForDate(ranges, ymd) {
00096:   for (const r of Array.isArray(ranges) ? ranges : []) {
00097:     const from0 = String(r?.from || "").trim();
00098:     const to0 = String(r?.to || "").trim();
00099: 
00100:     const hasFrom = isISODate(from0);
00101:     const hasTo = isISODate(to0);
00102: 
00103:     if (!hasFrom && !hasTo) return r;
00104:     if (!hasFrom && hasTo && ymd <= to0) return r;
00105:     if (hasFrom && !hasTo && ymd >= from0) return r;
00106:     if (hasFrom && hasTo && ymd >= from0 && ymd <= to0) return r;
00107:   }
00108: 
00109:   return null;
00110: }

00178:   const lk1 = String(draw?.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00179:   const lk2 = String(draw?.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00180:   return lk1 === TARGET_LOTTERY || lk2 === TARGET_LOTTERY;
00181: }

00183: async function fetchDay(db, ymd) {
00184:   const [s1, s2] = await Promise.all([
00185:     db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", ymd).get(),
00186:     db.collection("draws").where("ymd", "==", ymd).get(),
00187:   ]);
00188: 
00189:   const map = new Map();
00190:   for (const d of s1.docs) map.set(d.id, d);
00191:   for (const d of s2.docs) map.set(d.id, d);
00192: 
00193:   return Array.from(map.values());
00194: }

00250:             d.horario

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }
00037: 
00038: function normalizeCloseHourForPtRio(value) {
00039:   const raw = normalizeHHMM(value);
00040:   if (!raw) return "";
00041:   return `${raw.slice(0, 2)}:00`;
00042: }

00059: async function readFirestoreByDate(date) {
00060:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00061: 
00062:   const bySlot = new Map();
00063: 
00064:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00065:     const d = doc.data() || {};
00066:     const lk = String(d.lottery_key || d.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00067:     if (lk !== LOTTERY_KEY) continue;
00068: 
00069:     const slot = normalizeCloseHourForPtRio(d.close_hour || d.close || d.hour || "");
00070:     if (!slot) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const pSnap = await doc.ref.collection("prizes").get();
00073:     const prizes = {};
00074: 
00075:     pSnap.forEach((pdoc) => {
00076:       const p = pdoc.data() || {};
00077:       const pos = Number(p.position || String(pdoc.id || "").replace(/\D/g, ""));
00078:       const milhar = normMilhar(p.milhar || p.value || p.raw);
00079:       if (Number.isFinite(pos) && pos >= 1 && pos <= 7 && milhar) {
00080:         prizes[pos] = milhar;
00081:       }
00082:     });
00083: 
00084:     const row = {
00085:       id: doc.id,
00086:       slot,
00087:       prizes,
00088:       prizeCount: Object.keys(prizes).length,
00089:     };
00090: 
00091:     if (!bySlot.has(slot)) bySlot.set(slot, []);
00092:     bySlot.get(slot).push(row);
00093:   }
00094: 
00095:   return bySlot;
00096: }

00101:   return list[0] || null;

00123:   ).sort();

00138:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "missing_firestore" });

00104: async function auditDate(date) {
00105:   const payload = await fetchKingResults({ date, lotteryKey: LOTTERY_KEY });
00106:   const sourceDraws = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [];
00107: 
00108:   const sourceBySlot = new Map();
00109: 
00110:   for (const draw of sourceDraws) {
00111:     const slot = normalizeCloseHourForPtRio(draw?.close_hour || "");
00112:     if (!slot) continue;
00113:     sourceBySlot.set(slot, {
00114:       slot,
00115:       prizes: extractKingPrizes(draw),
00116:     });
00117:   }
00118: 
00119:   const fsBySlot = await readFirestoreByDate(date);
00120: 
00121:   const allSlots = Array.from(
00122:     new Set([...sourceBySlot.keys(), ...fsBySlot.keys()])
00123:   ).sort();
00124: 
00125:   const problems = [];
00126: 
00127:   for (const slot of allSlots) {
00128:     const src = sourceBySlot.get(slot);
00129:     const docs = fsBySlot.get(slot) || [];
00130:     const fsDoc = pickBestDoc(docs);
00131: 
00132:     if (!src) {
00133:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "extra_firestore", firestoreDocs: docs.map(x => x.id) });
00134:       continue;
00135:     }
00136: 
00137:     if (!fsDoc) {
00138:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "missing_firestore" });
00139:       continue;
00140:     }
00141: 
00142:     if (docs.length > 1) {
00143:       problems.push({ date, slot, type: "duplicate_firestore", count: docs.length, docs: docs.map(x => x.id) });
00144:     }
00145: 
00146:     for (let pos = 1; pos <= 7; pos++) {
00147:       const a = src.prizes[pos] || "";
00148:       const b = fsDoc.prizes[pos] || "";
00149: 
00150:       if (!a || !b || a !== b) {
00151:         problems.push({
00152:           date,
00153:           slot,
00154:           type: "prize_mismatch",
00155:           position: pos,
00156:           source: a,
00157:           firestore: b,
00158:           firestoreDoc: fsDoc.id,
00159:         });
00160:       }
00161:     }
00162:   }
00163: 
00164:   return {
00165:     date,
00166:     sourceSlots: Array.from(sourceBySlot.keys()).sort(),
00167:     firestoreSlots: Array.from(fsBySlot.keys()).sort(),
00168:     problems,
00169:   };
00170: }

00059: async function readFirestoreByDate(date) {
00060:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00061: 
00062:   const bySlot = new Map();
00063: 
00064:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {

00067:     if (lk !== LOTTERY_KEY) continue;
00068: 
00069:     const slot = normalizeCloseHourForPtRio(d.close_hour || d.close || d.hour || "");
00070:     if (!slot) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const pSnap = await doc.ref.collection("prizes").get();

00074: 
00075:     pSnap.forEach((pdoc) => {
00076:       const p = pdoc.data() || {};
00077:       const pos = Number(p.position || String(pdoc.id || "").replace(/\D/g, ""));
00078:       const milhar = normMilhar(p.milhar || p.value || p.raw);

00098: function pickBestDoc(arr) {
00099:   const list = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.slice() : [];
00100:   list.sort((a, b) => Number(b.prizeCount || 0) - Number(a.prizeCount || 0));
00101:   return list[0] || null;
00102: }

00598: function applyHolidayNoDrawToState({ state, statusMap, isoNow }) {
00599:   let touched = 0;
00600: 
00601:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00602:     let slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00603: 
00604:     if (!slot) {
00605:       slot = { hour: sched.hour, done: false, na: false, tries: 0 };
00606:       state[sched.hour] = slot;
00607:     }
00608: 
00609:     const st = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00610:     const applies = st === "HARD" || st === "SOFT";
00611:     if (!applies) continue;
00612: 
00613:     if (slot.done && slot.na && slot.naReason === "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW") continue;
00614: 
00615:     slot.done = true;
00616:     slot.na = true;
00617:     slot.naReason = "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW";
00618:     slot.lastTryISO = isoNow;
00619:     slot.lastResult = { ok: true, skipped: true, reason: "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW" };
00620:     touched += 1;
00621:   }
00622: 
00623:   return touched;
00624: }

00710: async function verifySlotPersistedViaBackend({ date, slotHHMM }) {
00711:   try {
00712:     const base = PITACO_API_BASE.replace(/\/+$/, "");
00713:     const u = `${base}/api/pitaco/results?date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}&lottery=${encodeURIComponent(LOTTERY)}`;
00714: 
00715:     const res = await axios.get(u, {
00716:       timeout: 15000,
00717:       validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00718:       headers: { "User-Agent": "palpitaco-autoImportToday" },
00719:     });
00720: 
00721:     const j = res && res.data ? res.data : null;
00722:     if (!j || typeof j !== "object") return { ok: false, reason: "BAD_JSON" };
00723: 
00724:     const draws = Array.isArray(j.draws) ? j.draws : [];
00725:     const foundInDraws = draws.some((d) => drawLooksLikeSlot(d, slotHHMM));
00726:     if (foundInDraws) return { ok: true, where: "draws", drawsCount: draws.length };
00727: 
00728:     const slots = Array.isArray(j.slots) ? j.slots : [];
00729:     const hh = hhFromSlotHHMM(slotHHMM);
00730: 
00731:     const foundInSlots = slots.some((s) => {
00732:       const v = (s && (s.hour || s.close_hour || s.closeHour || s.close || s.slot || s.time || s.close_hour_raw)) ?? "";
00733:       const t = String(v).trim();
00734:       return t.startsWith(hh);
00735:     });
00736: 
00737:     if (foundInSlots) return { ok: true, where: "slots", slotsCount: slots.length };
00738: 
00739:     return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND", drawsCount: draws.length, slotsCount: slots.length };
00740:   } catch (e) {
00741:     const code = e?.code || e?.cause?.code || "";
00742:     const msg = e?.message || e?.cause?.message || String(e);
00743:     const r = code ? `${code}:${msg}` : msg;
00744:     return { ok: false, reason: `EX:${r}` };
00745:   }

00710: async function verifySlotPersistedViaBackend({ date, slotHHMM }) {
00711:   try {

00714:

00716:       timeout: 15000,
00717:       validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00718:       headers: { "User-Agent": "palpitaco-autoImportToday" },
00719:     });
00720: 
00721:     const j = res && res.data ? res.data : null;
00722:     if (!j || typeof j !== "object") return { ok: false, reason: "BAD_JSON" };
00723:

00726:     if (foundInDraws) return { ok: true, where: "draws", drawsCount: draws.length };

00740:   } catch (e) {

00742:     const msg = e?.message || e?.cause?.message || String(e);

00787: /**
00788:  * Reconcilia o state temporário do runner com os horários
00789:  * realmente presentes no backend/Firestore.
00790:  */
00791: function syncStateFromBackendSnapshot({
00792:   state,
00793:   statusMap,
00794:   daySnapshot,
00795:   isoNow,
00796: }) {
00797:   const rawPresentHours = Array.isArray(daySnapshot?.presentHours)
00798:     ? daySnapshot.presentHours
00799:     : [];
00800: 
00801:   const presentHours = new Set(
00802:     rawPresentHours
00803:       .map((value) => {
00804:         const match = String(value ?? "").trim().match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00805:         if (!match) return "";
00806: 
00807:         const hour = Number(match[1]);
00808:         if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || hour < 0 || hour > 23) return "";
00809: 
00810:         return pad2(hour);
00811:       })
00812:       .filter(Boolean)
00813:   );
00814: 
00815:   if (!presentHours.size) return 0;
00816: 
00817:   let touched = 0;
00818: 
00819:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00820:     const slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00821:     if (!slot || slot.done || slot.na) continue;
00822: 
00823:     const calendar = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00824:     if (calendar !== "HARD" && calendar !== "SOFT") continue;
00825: 
00826:     const hour = String(sched.hour || "").slice(0, 2);
00827:     if (!presentHours.has(hour)) continue;
00828: 
00829:     slot.done = true;
00830:     slot.na = false;
00831:     slot.naReason = null;
00832:     slot.lastTryISO = slot.lastTryISO || isoNow;
00833:     slot.lastResult = {
00834:       ...(slot.lastResult || {}),
00835:       ok: true,
00836:       reconciledFromBackend: true,
00837:       reason: "BACKEND_PRESENT_HOUR",
00838:       presentHour: hour,
00839:     };
00840:     slot.alertMissedWindow = false;
00841:     slot.alertCritical = false;
00842: 
00843:     touched += 1;
00844: 
00845:     logLine(
00846:       `[STATE-SYNC] backend confirmou slot=${sched.hour} presente -> DONE`,
00847:       "INFO"
00848:     );
00849:   }
00850: 
00851:   return touched;
00852: }

00931: function emitHardAlertsIfNeeded({ date, nowMin, state, statusMap }) {
00932:   let touched = false;
00933: 
00934:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00935:     let slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00936: 
00937:     if (!slot) {
00938:       slot = { hour: sched.hour, done: false, na: false, tries: 0 };
00939:       state[sched.hour] = slot;
00940:     }
00941: 
00942:     if (slot.done || slot.na) continue;
00943: 
00944:     const st = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00945:     if (st !== "HARD") continue;
00946: 
00947:     const w = slotWindow(sched);
00948:     if (nowMin < w.release) continue;
00949: 
00950:     const since = nowMin - w.release;
00951: 
00952:     if (nowMin > w.end && !slot.alertMissedWindow) {
00953:       slot.alertMissedWindow = true;
00954:       touched = true;
00955:       logLine(
00956:         `[ALERT] HARD slot perdeu janela: date=${date} slot=${sched.hour} releaseAt=${w.releaseLabel} windowEnd=${w.endLabel} tries=${slot.tries || 0}`,
00957:         "ERROR"
00958:       );
00959:     }
00960: 
00961:     if (since >= CRIT_AFTER_MIN && !slot.alertCritical) {
00962:       slot.alertCritical = true;
00963:       touched = true;
00964:       logLine(
00965:         `[ALERT] HARD slot CRITICAL: date=${date} slot=${sched.hour} since=${since}min (>=${CRIT_AFTER_MIN}) tries=${slot.tries || 0}`,
00966:         "ERROR"
00967:       );
00968:     }
00969:   }
00970: 
00971:   return touched;
00972: }

00059: function closeCandidates(hhmm, tol) {
00060:   const base = normalizeHHMM(hhmm);
00061:   if (!isHHMM(base)) return [];
00062: 
00063:   const baseH = Number(base.slice(0, 2));
00064:   const baseM = Number(base.slice(3, 5));
00065: 
00066:   const t = Number.isFinite(Number(tol)) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(15, Number(tol))) : 2;
00067: 
00068:   const out = [];
00069:   for (let d = -t; d <= t; d++) {
00070:     let h = baseH;
00071:     let m = baseM + d;
00072: 
00073:     if (m < 0) {
00074:       h -= 1;
00075:       m += 60;
00076:     } else if (m > 59) {
00077:       h += 1;
00078:       m -= 60;
00079:     }
00080: 
00081:     if (h < 0 || h > 23) continue;
00082: 
00083:     out.push(`${pad2(h)}:${pad2(m)}`);
00084:   }
00085: 
00086:   return Array.from(new Set(out));
00087: }

00111:   gaps.gapsByDay = gaps.gapsByDay || {};
00112: 
00113:   // Motivos que indicam que aquele "missingHour" não deve mais ficar no gaps:
00114:   // - API_NO_SLOT = fonte não tem aquele slot
00115:   // - FS_ALREADY_HAS/CAPTURED/UPDATED... = já está resolvido no Firestore
00116:   const REMOVE_REASONS = new Set([
00117:     "API_NO_SLOT",
00118:     "FS_ALREADY_HAS",
00119:     "CAPTURED",
00120:     "UPDATED",
00121:     "UPDATED_SLOT",
00122:     "UPDATED_SLOTS",
00123:   ]);
00124: 
00125:   const toRemove = new Map();
00126: 
00127:   // o seu report atual usa report.results[], com day.attempted[]
00128:   const days = Array.isArray(report.results) ? report.results : [];
00129: 
00130:   for (const dayRes of days) {
00131:     const ymd = safeStr(dayRes.ymd || dayRes.date);
00132:     if (!ymd) continue;
00133: 
00134:     const attempted = Array.isArray(dayRes.attempted) ? dayRes.attempted : [];
00135:     for (const slotRes of attempted) {
00136:       const reason = safeStr(slotRes?.doneReason);
00137:       if (!REMOVE_REASONS.has(reason)) continue;
00138: 
00139:       const hourNum = toNum(slotRes?.hour);
00140:       if (hourNum == null) continue;
00141: 
00142:       if (!toRemove.has(ymd)) toRemove.set(ymd, new Set());
00143:       toRemove.get(ymd).add(hourNum);
00144:     }
00145:   }
00146: 
00147:   let removedHard = 0;
00148:   let removedSoft = 0;
00149:   let daysTouched = 0;
00150: 
00151:   for (const [ymd, hoursSet] of toRemove.entries()) {
00152:     const day = gaps.gapsByDay[ymd];
00153:     if (!day) continue;
00154: 
00155:     const hard = Array.isArray(day.removedHard) ? day.removedHard : [];
00156:     const soft = Array.isArray(day.removedSoft) ? day.removedSoft : [];
00157: 
00158:     const hardNums = hard.map(toNum).filter((n) => n != null);
00159:     const softNums = soft.map(toNum).filter((n) => n != null);
00160: 
00161:     const newHardNums = hardNums.filter((h) => !hoursSet.has(h));
00162:     const newSoftNums = softNums.filter((h) => !hoursSet.has(h));
00163: 
00164:     const dh = hardNums.length - newHardNums.length;
00165:     const ds = softNums.length - newSoftNums.length;
00166: 
00167:     if (dh || ds) {
00168:       removedHard += dh;

00086: function ymdInRange(ymd, from, to) {
00087:   if (!ymd) return false;
00088:   if (from && ymd < from) return false;
00089:   if (to && ymd > to) return false;
00090:   return true;
00091: }

00093: function safeFilePart(s) {
00094:   return String(s ?? "")
00095:     .trim()
00096:     .replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g, "_")
00097:     .slice(0, 120);
00098: }

00313: function isISODate(s) {
00314:   return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
00315: }
00316: 
00317: function isHHMM(s) {
00318:   return /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
00319: }
00320: 
00321: /**
00322:  * Normaliza horário para HH:MM (raw)
00323:  * Aceita: "10", "10h", "10:9", "10:09"
00324:  */
00325: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00326:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00327:   if (!s) return "";
00328: 
00329:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;
00330: 
00331:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00332:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00333: 
00334:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00335:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00336: 
00337:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00338:   if (m3) {
00339:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00340:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00341:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00342:   }
00343: 
00344:   return "";
00345: }
00346: 
00347: /**
00348:  * ✅ Normaliza close_hour para SLOT (campo de negócio)
00349:  * - Para PT_RIO: força minutos = 00 (09:09 -> 09:00)
00350:  * - Para outros: preserva raw
00351:  *
00352:  * Correção crítica:
00353:  * - A API do PT_RIO costuma devolver HH:09 como "marcação" e NÃO um minuto real.
00354:  * - Portanto, para PT_RIO, se raw terminar em ":09", tratamos como "sem minuto real"
00355:  *   e NÃO persistimos close_hour_raw (vira "").
00356:  *
00357:  * Retorna:
00358:  * - raw: HH:MM (normalizado) OU "" quando for "sintético" (PT_RIO HH:09)
00359:  * - slot: HH:MM (normalizado para o que o sistema deve usar em consultas/ID)
00360:  */
00361: function normalizeCloseHourForLottery(value, lotteryKey) {
00362:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00363:   const raw0 = normalizeHHMM(value);
00364:   if (!raw0 || !isHHMM(raw0)) return { raw: "", slot: "" };
00365: 
00366:   // ✅ FEDERAL: slot de negócio é sempre 20:00, mas preserva o raw
00367:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00368:     return { raw: raw0, slot: "20:00" };
00369:   }
00370: 
00371:   if (lk === "PT_RIO") {
00372:     const hh = raw0.slice(0, 2);
00373:     const mm = raw0.slice(3, 5);
00374: 
00375:     // ✅ se vier HH:09, é marcação (não minuto real) -> não grava close_hour_raw
00376:     const raw = mm === "09" ? "" : raw0;
00377:     return { raw, slot: `${hh}:00` };
00378:   }
00379: 
00380:   return { raw: raw0, slot: raw0 };
00381: }
00382: 
00383: /**
00384:  * ✅ Normaliza o parâmetro closeHour (do CLI/scheduler) e evita log enganoso.
00385:  * - Para FEDERAL: qualquer coisa vira slot=20:00, mas mantemos "requested" para log.
00386:  */
00387: function normalizeRequestedCloseHour(closeHour, lotteryKey) {
00388:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00389:   const requested = closeHour ? normalizeHHMM(closeHour) : null;
00390:   const requestedIsValid = requested ? isHHMM(requested) : false;
00391: 
00392:   if (!requested) {
00393:     return { requested: null, slot: null, note: null };
00394:   }
00395:   if (!requestedIsValid) {
00396:     return { requested, slot: null, note: "invalid" };
00397:   }
00398: 
00399:   // FEDERAL: slot único 20:00 (não fingir que o usuário pediu 20:00)
00400:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00401:     const slot = "20:00";
00402:     const note = requested !== slot ? `FEDERAL_slot_fixed(${requested}->${slot})` : null;
00403:     return { requested, slot, note };
00404:   }
00405: 
00406:   // outros: normalização normal por lotteryKey (PT_RIO min->00 etc.)
00407:   const slot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(requested, lk).slot;
00408:   return { requested, slot: slot || null, note: null };
00409: }
00410: 
00411: /**
00412:  * Sanitiza string para docId do Firestore.
00413:  */
00414: function safeIdPart(input) {
00415:   const s = String(input ?? "").trim();
00416:   if (!s) return "NA";
00417:   return s

00317: function isHHMM(s) {
00318:   return /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());

00321: /**
00322:  * Normaliza horário para HH:MM (raw)
00323:  * Aceita: "10", "10h", "10:9", "10:09"
00324:  */
00325: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00326:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00327:   if (!s) return "";
00328: 
00329:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;
00330: 
00331:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00332:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00333: 
00334:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00335:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00336: 
00337:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00338:   if (m3) {
00339:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00340:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00341:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00342:   }
00343: 
00344:   return "";
00345: }

00347: /**
00348:  * ✅ Normaliza close_hour para SLOT (campo de negócio)
00349:  * - Para PT_RIO: força minutos = 00 (09:09 -> 09:00)
00350:  * - Para outros: preserva raw
00351:  *
00352:  * Correção crítica:
00353:  * - A API do PT_RIO costuma devolver HH:09 como "marcação" e NÃO um minuto real.
00354:  * - Portanto, para PT_RIO, se raw terminar em ":09", tratamos como "sem minuto real"
00355:  *   e NÃO persistimos close_hour_raw (vira "").
00356:  *
00357:  * Retorna:
00358:  * - raw: HH:MM (normalizado) OU "" quando for "sintético" (PT_RIO HH:09)
00359:  * - slot: HH:MM (normalizado para o que o sistema deve usar em consultas/ID)
00360:  */
00361: function normalizeCloseHourForLottery(value, lotteryKey) {
00362:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00363:   const raw0 = normalizeHHMM(value);
00364:   if (!raw0 || !isHHMM(raw0)) return { raw: "", slot: "" };
00365: 
00366:   // ✅ FEDERAL: slot de negócio é sempre 20:00, mas preserva o raw
00367:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00368:     return { raw: raw0, slot: "20:00" };
00369:   }
00370: 
00371:   if (lk === "PT_RIO") {
00372:     const hh = raw0.slice(0, 2);
00373:     const mm = raw0.slice(3, 5);
00374: 
00375:     // ✅ se vier HH:09, é marcação (não minuto real) -> não grava close_hour_raw
00376:     const raw = mm === "09" ? "" : raw0;
00377:     return { raw, slot: `${hh}:00` };
00378:   }
00379: 
00380:   return { raw: raw0, slot: raw0 };
00381: }

00523: function sleep(ms) {
00524:   return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

00526: 
00527: function shouldRetryAxiosError(err) {
00528:   const code = String(err?.code || "").toLowerCase();
00529:   const status = Number(err?.response?.status);
00530: 
00531:   if (
00532:     code.includes("etimedout") ||
00533:     code.includes("econnreset") ||
00534:     code.includes("enotfound")
00535:   ) {
00536:     return true;
00537:   }
00538: 
00539:   // 429 / 5xx
00540:   if (
00541:     Number.isFinite(status) &&
00542:     (status === 429 || (status >= 500 && status <= 599))
00543:   ) {
00544:     return true;
00545:   }
00546: 
00547:   return false;
00548: }

00550: async function axiosGetJson(url) {
00551:   let lastErr = null;
00552: 
00553:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= HTTP_RETRIES; attempt++) {
00554:     try {
00555:       const { data } = await axios.get(url, {
00556:         headers: {
00557:           Accept: "application/json, text/plain, */*",
00558:           Origin: "https://app.kingapostas.com",
00559:           Referer: "https://app.kingapostas.com/",
00560:         },
00561:         timeout: 30000,
00562:         validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 300,
00563:       });
00564: 
00565:       if (!data?.success || !Array.isArray(data?.data)) {
00566:         throw new Error("Resposta inesperada da API (success/data).");
00567:       }
00568: 
00569:       return data;
00570:     } catch (e) {
00571:       lastErr = e;
00572: 
00573:       const canRetry = attempt < HTTP_RETRIES && shouldRetryAxiosError(e);
00574:       if (!canRetry) break;
00575: 
00576:       const backoff = HTTP_RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt);
00577:       console.warn(
00578:         `[HTTP] tentativa ${attempt + 1}/${HTTP_RETRIES + 1} falhou (${
00579:           e?.response?.status || e?.code || "err"
00580:         }). retry em ${backoff}ms...`
00581:       );
00582:       await sleep(backoff);
00583:     }
00584:   }
00585: 
00586:   throw lastErr || new Error("Falha ao buscar API.");
00587: }

00615:             "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
00616:           Origin: "https://app.kingapostas.com",
00617:           Referer: "https://app.kingapostas.com/",
00618:           "User-Agent":
00619:             "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Safari/537.36",
00620:         },
00621:         timeout: 30000,
00622:         responseType: "text",
00623:         validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00624:       });
00625:       return String(data || "");
00626:     } catch (e) {
00627:       lastErr = e;
00628:       const canRetry = attempt < HTTP_RETRIES && shouldRetryAxiosError(e);
00629:       if (!canRetry) break;
00630: 
00631:       const backoff = HTTP_RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt);
00632:       console.warn(
00633:         `[HTTP] tentativa ${attempt + 1}/${HTTP_RETRIES + 1} (HTML) falhou (${
00634:           e?.response?.status || e?.code || "err"
00635:         }). retry em ${backoff}ms...`
00636:       );
00637:       await sleep(backoff);
00638:     }
00639:   }
00640: 
00641:   throw lastErr || new Error("Falha ao buscar HTML");
00642: }

00644: /**
00645:  * Detecta se o HTML é uma página de login/redirect (evita falso positivo).
00646:  */
00647: function detectDetailsHtmlKind(html) {
00648:   const h = String(html || "");
00649:   const low = h.toLowerCase();
00650: 
00651:   // sinais comuns:
00652:   if (low.includes("/login/sign-in") || low.includes("formlogin")) return "login";
00653:   if (low.includes("bailout_to_client_side_rendering")) return "csr_bailout";
00654:   if (low.includes("app/login") || low.includes("sign-in")) return "login_like";
00655: 
00656:   // fallback: parece uma página de results
00657:   if (low.includes("results/details") || low.includes("kingapostas"))
00658:     return "results_like";
00659: 
00660:   return "unknown";
00661: }

00663: // Heurística: só diagnosticar se o HTML "parece" ter o slot e algum conteúdo de prêmios
00664: function parseDetailsHtmlForSlot(html, slotHHMM) {
00665:   const out = {
00666:     hasSlot: false,
00667:     hasAnyPrize: false,
00668:     kind: "unknown",
00669:   };
00670:   const h = String(html || "");
00671:   const slot = String(slotHHMM || "").trim();
00672:   if (!h || !slot) return out;
00673: 
00674:   out.kind = detectDetailsHtmlKind(h);
00675: 
00676:   // Se é login/redirect, não confia em nada
00677:   if (out.kind === "login" || out.kind === "login_like") {
00678:     return out;
00679:   }
00680: 
00681:   if (h.toLowerCase().includes(slot.toLowerCase())) out.hasSlot = true;
00682: 
00683:   // mantém heurística, mas só vale quando não for login
00684:   if (/(prize[_\s-]?\d+)|(\b\d{4}\b)/i.test(h)) out.hasAnyPrize = true;
00685: 
00686:   return out;
00687: }

00713: /**
00714:  * ✅ Merge + dedup de draws vindos de múltiplos requests
00715:  * Dedup key: date + close_hour(SLOT) + lottery_id (se existir)
00716:  */
00717: function mergeAndDedupDraws(arrays, lotteryKey) {
00718:   const map = new Map();
00719: 
00720:   for (const a of arrays) {
00721:     const list = Array.isArray(a) ? a : [];
00722:     for (const d of list) {
00723:       const date = String(d?.date || "").trim();
00724:       const { slot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d?.close_hour || "", lotteryKey);
00725: 
00726:       const lid =
00727:         pickLotteryId(d) ||
00728:         String(d?.lottery_name || d?.name || "").trim() ||
00729:         "NA";
00730:       const key = `${date}__${slot}__${lid}`;
00731: 
00732:       if (!map.has(key)) {
00733:         map.set(key, d);
00734:       } else {
00735:         // se duplicado, preferir o que tiver mais prizes preenchidos
00736:         const prev = map.get(key);
00737:         const prevCount = countPrizesInDraw(prev);
00738:         const curCount = countPrizesInDraw(d);
00739:         if (curCount > prevCount) map.set(key, d);
00740:       }
00741:     }
00742:   }
00743: 
00744:   return Array.from(map.values());
00745: }
00746: 
00747: function countPrizesInDraw(draw) {
00748:   let c = 0;
00749:   for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) {
00750:     const v = draw?.[`prize_${i}`];
00751:     if (v === null || v === undefined || String(v).trim() === "") continue;
00752:     c++;
00753:   }
00754:   return c;
00755: }

00930:  * ✅ Prova forte por SLOT (anti-índice composto)
00931:  * - Query filtra SOMENTE por date
00932:  * - close_hour + lottery_key/lotteryKey filtrados em memória
00933:  *
00934:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00935:  * - Normaliza o close_hour armazenado (pode existir legado "09:09")
00936:  *   e compara por SLOT (HH:00), para não “perder” doc existente.
00937:  */
00938: async function checkSlotCompletion({ date, closeHour, lotteryKey }) {
00939:   try {
00940:     const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00941:     const targetSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(closeHour || "", lk).slot;
00942:     if (!targetSlot || !isHHMM(targetSlot)) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00943: 
00944:     // query mínima
00945:     const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00946:     if (snap.empty) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00947: 
00948:     const refs = [];
00949:     snap.forEach((doc) => {
00950:       const d = doc.data() || {};
00951: 
00952:       const lkSnake = String(d.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00953:       const lkCamel = String(d.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00954: 
00955:       if (lkSnake !== lk && lkCamel !== lk) return;
00956: 
00957:       // ✅ compara por SLOT normalizado (pega legado "09:09" como "09:00")
00958:       const storedSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d.close_hour || "", lk).slot;
00959:       if (storedSlot !== targetSlot) return;
00960: 
00961:       refs.push(doc.ref);
00962:     });
00963: 
00964:     if (!refs.length) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00965: 
00966:     let complete = 0;
00967:     for (const ref of refs) {
00968:       const ok = await checkAlreadyComplete(ref);
00969:       if (ok) complete += 1;
00970:     }
00971: 
00972:     return { docs: refs.length, complete };
00973:   } catch {
00974:     return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00975:   }
00976: }
00977:

00983:  * - skipIfAlreadyComplete (boolean): se true, e o draw do closeHour já estiver completo no FS,
00984:  *   então NÃO escreve nada (evita ruído e falsos positivos).

01256: /**
01257:  * ✅ Cleanup automático: remove docs legados (lottery_id null) quando existe doc UUID no mesmo date+slot.
01258:  * - Usa query mínima por date (sem índice composto)
01259:  * - Seguro: só apaga legado se existe UUID no slot
01260:  */
01261: async function cleanupLegacyDrawsForDate({ date, lotteryKey }) {
01262:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
01263:   if (!date || !isISODate(date) || !lk)
01264:     return { ok: false, deleted: 0, slots: 0, reason: "bad_args" };
01265: 
01266:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
01267:   const rows = snap.docs.map((doc) => ({ ref: doc.ref, id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }));
01268: 
01269:   const mine = rows.filter(
01270:     (r) => String(r.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase() === lk
01271:   );
01272: 
01273:   const bySlot = new Map();
01274:   for (const r of mine) {
01275:     const slot = String(r.close_hour || "").trim();
01276:     if (!slot) continue;
01277:     if (!bySlot.has(slot)) bySlot.set(slot, []);
01278:     bySlot.get(slot).push(r);
01279:   }
01280: 
01281:   let deleted = 0;
01282:   let slots = 0;
01283:   let batch = db.batch();
01284:   let ops = 0;
01285: 
01286:   for (const [slot, arr] of bySlot.entries()) {
01287:     const hasUuid = arr.some((x) => x.lottery_id && String(x.lottery_id).includes("-"));
01288:     if (!hasUuid) continue;
01289: 
01290:     const leg = arr.filter((x) => !x.lottery_id);
01291:     if (!leg.length) continue;
01292: 
01293:     for (const d of leg) {
01294:       batch.delete(d.ref);
01295:       deleted += 1;
01296:       ops += 1;
01297:       if (ops >= 450) {
01298:         await batch.commit();
01299:         batch = db.batch();
01300:         ops = 0;
01301:       }
01302:     }
01303:     slots += 1;
01304:   }
01305: 
01306:   if (ops > 0) await batch.commit();
01307: 
01308:   return { ok: true, deleted, slots };
01309: }

01697:           closeHour: normalizedClose,
01698:         });
01699:         if (fb.ok) {
01700:           console.warn(

01702:           );
01703:         }
01704:       } catch {}
01705: 
01706:       process.exit(0);
01707:     }
01708:   }
01709: 
01710:   console.log(

01712:     } draws retornados pela API...`
01713:   );

01716:     payload,
01717:     lotteryKey: lk,

01719:     skipIfAlreadyComplete: false, // CLI regrava
01720:   });
01721: 
01722:   console.log(
01723:     `STEP 3/3 OK. Import concluído: ${lk} ${date}${normalizedClose ? ` ${normalizedClose}` : ""
01724:     }`
01725:   );
01726: 
01727:   // ✅ cleanup automático de legado (somente quando per-lottery está ON)
01728:   if (FETCH_PER_LOTTERY) {
01729:     try {
01730:       const c = await cleanupLegacyDrawsForDate({ date, lotteryKey: lk });
01731:       if (c && c.ok && c.deleted) {

01733:       } else {

01735:       }
01736:     } catch (e) {
01737:       console.warn(`[CLEANUP] ${lk} ${date} ERROR=${String(e?.message || e || "")}`);
01738:     }
01739:   }
01740: }
01741: 
01742: if (require.main === module) {
01743:   main().catch((e) => {
01744:     console.error("ERRO:", e?.message || e);
01745:     process.exit(1);
01746:   });
01747: }

00016: 
00017: function isISODateStrict(s) {
00018:   const str = String(s ?? "").trim();
00019:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00020:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00021:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00022:   return (
00023:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00024:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00025:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00026:   );
00027: }
00028: 
00029: function normHour(x) {
00030:   // aceita 21, "21", "21h", "21:00", "21:30" -> "21"
00031:   const m = String(x ?? "").trim().match(/\b(\d{1,2})\b/);
00032:   if (!m) return "";
00033:   const n = Number(m[1]);
00034:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 23) return "";
00035:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00036: }
00037: 
00038: function readJson(p) {
00039:   try {
00040:     const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
00041:     return JSON.parse(raw);
00042:   } catch (err) {
00043:     const msg = err?.message || String(err);
00044:     throw new Error(`Falha ao ler/parsear JSON: ${p} | ${msg}`);
00045:   }
00046: }
00047: 
00048: async function existsDraw(db, lotteryKey, ymd, hh) {
00049:   if (!hh) return false;
00050:   const close = `${hh}:00`;
00051: 
00052:   const snap = await db
00053:     .collection("draws")
00054:     .where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey)
00055:     .where("ymd", "==", ymd)
00056:     .where("close_hour", "==", close)
00057:     .limit(1)
00058:     .get();
00059: 
00060:   return !snap.empty;
00061: }
00062: 
00063: async function main() {
00064:   const lotteryArg = process.argv[2] || "PT_RIO";
00065:   const lotteryKey = normalizeLotteryKey(lotteryArg);
00066:   if (!lotteryKey) {
00067:     console.error(`ERRO: lottery inválida: ${String(lotteryArg)}`);
00068:     process.exit(1);
00069:   }
00070: 
00071:   const from = String(process.argv[3] || "2022-06-07").trim();
00072:   const to = String(process.argv[4] || "2099-12-31").trim();
00073: 
00074:   if (!isISODateStrict(from) || !isISODateStrict(to) || from > to) {
00075:     console.error(`ERRO: range inválido. Use YYYY-MM-DD. from=${from} to=${to}`);
00076:     process.exit(1);
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   const gapsPath = path.join(__dirname, "..", "data", "source_gaps", `${lotteryKey}.json`);
00080:   if (!fs.existsSync(gapsPath)) {
00081:     console.error("ERRO: arquivo não encontrado:", gapsPath);
00082:     process.exit(1);
00083:   }
00084: 
00085:   const g = readJson(gapsPath);
00086:   const by = g.gapsByDay || {};
00087:   const days = Object.keys(by)
00088:     .filter((d) => isISODateStrict(d) && d >= from && d <= to)
00089:     .sort();
00090: 
00091:   const db = getDb();
00092:   let contradictions = 0;
00093: 
00094:   for (const ymd of days) {
00095:     const e = by[ymd] || {};
00096:     const removedHardRaw = Array.isArray(e.removedHard) ? e.removedHard : [];
00097:     const removedHard = Array.from(new Set(removedHardRaw.map(normHour).filter(Boolean)));
00098: 
00099:     if (!removedHard.length) continue;
00100: 
00101:     const results = await Promise.all(
00102:       removedHard.map(async (hh) => {
00103:         const ok = await existsDraw(db, lotteryKey, ymd, hh);
00104:         return { hh, ok };
00105:       })
00106:     );
00107: 
00108:     for (const r of results) {
00109:       if (r.ok) {
00110:         contradictions++;
00111:         console.log(`[CONTRADICTION] ${ymd} removedHard ${r.hh} but DRAW EXISTS`);
00112:       }
00113:     }
00114:   }

00022:   return (

00024:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00025:     dt.getUTCDate() === d

00029: function normHour(x) {
00030:   // aceita 21, "21", "21h", "21:00", "21:30" -> "21"
00031:   const m = String(x ?? "").trim().match(/\b(\d{1,2})\b/);
00032:   if (!m) return "";
00033:   const n = Number(m[1]);
00034:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 23) return "";
00035:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00036: }

00038: function readJson(p) {
00039:   try {
00040:     const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
00041:     return JSON.parse(raw);
00042:   } catch (err) {
00043:     const msg = err?.message || String(err);
00044:     throw new Error(`Falha ao ler/parsear JSON: ${p} | ${msg}`);
00045:   }
00046: }

00048: async function existsDraw(db, lotteryKey, ymd, hh) {
00049:   if (!hh) return false;
00050:   const close = `${hh}:00`;
00051: 
00052:   const snap = await db
00053:     .collection("draws")
00054:     .where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey)
00055:     .where("ymd", "==", ymd)
00056:     .where("close_hour", "==", close)
00057:     .limit(1)
00058:     .get();
00059: 
00060:   return !snap.empty;
00061: }

00063: async function main() {
00064:   const lotteryArg = process.argv[2] || "PT_RIO";
00065:   const lotteryKey = normalizeLotteryKey(lotteryArg);
00066:   if (!lotteryKey) {
00067:     console.error(`ERRO: lottery inválida: ${String(lotteryArg)}`);
00068:     process.exit(1);
00069:   }
00070: 
00071:   const from = String(process.argv[3] || "2022-06-07").trim();
00072:   const to = String(process.argv[4] || "2099-12-31").trim();
00073: 
00074:   if (!isISODateStrict(from) || !isISODateStrict(to) || from > to) {
00075:     console.error(`ERRO: range inválido. Use YYYY-MM-DD. from=${from} to=${to}`);
00076:     process.exit(1);
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   const gapsPath = path.join(__dirname, "..", "data", "source_gaps", `${lotteryKey}.json`);
00080:   if (!fs.existsSync(gapsPath)) {
00081:     console.error("ERRO: arquivo não encontrado:", gapsPath);
00082:     process.exit(1);
00083:   }
00084: 
00085:   const g = readJson(gapsPath);
00086:   const by = g.gapsByDay || {};
00087:   const days = Object.keys(by)
00088:     .filter((d) => isISODateStrict(d) && d >= from && d <= to)
00089:     .sort();
00090: 
00091:   const db = getDb();
00092:   let contradictions = 0;
00093: 
00094:   for (const ymd of days) {
00095:     const e = by[ymd] || {};
00096:     const removedHardRaw = Array.isArray(e.removedHard) ? e.removedHard : [];
00097:     const removedHard = Array.from(new Set(removedHardRaw.map(normHour).filter(Boolean)));
00098: 
00099:     if (!removedHard.length) continue;
00100: 
00101:     const results = await Promise.all(
00102:       removedHard.map(async (hh) => {
00103:         const ok = await existsDraw(db, lotteryKey, ymd, hh);
00104:         return { hh, ok };
00105:       })
00106:     );
00107: 
00108:     for (const r of results) {
00109:       if (r.ok) {
00110:         contradictions++;
00111:         console.log(`[CONTRADICTION] ${ymd} removedHard ${r.hh} but DRAW EXISTS`);
00112:       }
00113:     }
00114:   }
00115: 
00116:   console.log("==================================");
00117:   console.log(`[LINT] lottery=${lotteryKey} range=${from}..${to}`);
00118:   console.log(`[LINT] contradictions=${contradictions}`);
00119:   console.log("==================================");
00120: 
00121:   process.exit(contradictions ? 2 : 0);
00122: }
00123: 
00124: main().catch((err) => {
00125:   console.error("ERRO:", err?.stack || err?.message || err);
00126:   process.exit(1);
00127: });

00179: async function main() {
00180:   const args = parseArgs(process.argv);

00182:

00187:   console.log("limit:", args.limit || "none");
00188:   console.log("startAfter:", args.startAfter || "none");
00189:   console.log("sampleInvalid:", args.sampleInvalid || 0);
00190:   console.log("======================================");
00191:

00193: 
00194:   const PAGE = 500;
00195:   const BATCH_MAX = 450;
00196: 
00197:   let processed = 0;
00198:   let skipped = 0;
00199:   let wouldUpdate = 0;
00200:   let updated = 0;
00201:   let invalidNoCandidate = 0;
00202: 
00203:   const invalidSamples = [];
00204:   let lastDoc = null;
00205: 
00206:   if (args.startAfter) {
00207:     const startSnap = await col.doc(args.startAfter).get();
00208:     if (startSnap.exists) {
00209:       lastDoc = startSnap;
00210:     } else {
00211:       console.log("[WARN] startAfter docId não existe. Ignorando:", args.startAfter);
00212:     }
00213:   }
00214: 
00215:   while (true) {
00216:     if (args.limit && processed >= args.limit) break;
00217:

00219:     if (lastDoc) q = q.startAfter(lastDoc);
00220:

00222:     if (snap.empty) break;
00223: 
00224:     const writes = [];
00225: 
00226:     for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00227:       if (args.limit && processed >= args.limit) break;
00228: 
00229:       processed += 1;
00230: 
00231:       const d = doc.data() || {};
00232:       const currentYmd = String(d.ymd || "").trim();
00233: 
00234:       if (isValidYMD(currentYmd)) {
00235:         skipped += 1;
00236:         lastDoc = doc;
00237:         continue;
00238:       }
00239:

00241:       const ymd = normalizeToYMD(cand);
00242: 
00243:       if (!ymd || !isValidYMD(ymd)) {
00244:         invalidNoCandidate += 1;
00245: 
00246:         if (args.sampleInvalid && invalidSamples.length < args.sampleInvalid) {
00247:           invalidSamples.push({
00248:             id: doc.id,
00249:             ymd: d.ymd ?? null,
00250:             date: d.date ?? null,
00251:             data: d.data ?? null,
00252:             dt: d.dt ?? null,
00253:             close_date: d.close_date ?? null,

00256:             closeDate: d.closeDate ?? null,

00258:             cand: cand ?? null,
00259:           });
00260:         }
00261: 
00262:         lastDoc = doc;
00263:         continue;
00264:       }
00265: 
00266:       writes.push({ ref: doc.ref, ymd });
00267:       lastDoc = doc;
00268:     }
00269:

00271:       console.log(
