00010: // ✅ ISO estrito (evita 2026-99-99 passar no regex)
00011: function isISODateStrict(s) {
00012:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00013:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00014: 
00015:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00016:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00017:   return (
00018:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00019:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00020:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00021:   );
00022: }

00039: function hourFromCloseHour(closeHour) {
00040:   const s0 = String(closeHour ?? "").trim();
00041:   if (!s0) return null;
00042: 
00043:   const m = s0.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00044:   if (!m) return null;
00045:

00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || hh < 0 || hh > 23) return null;
00048: 
00049:   return pad2(hh);
00050: }

00094: function walkFiles(dir, { maxFiles = 8000 } = {}) {
00095:   const out = [];
00096:   const stack = [dir];
00097: 
00098:   while (stack.length) {
00099:     const cur = stack.pop();
00100:     let entries = [];
00101:     try {
00102:       entries = fs.readdirSync(cur, { withFileTypes: true });
00103:     } catch {
00104:       continue;
00105:     }
00106: 
00107:     for (const ent of entries) {
00108:       const fp = path.join(cur, ent.name);
00109:       if (ent.isDirectory()) {
00110:         if (ent.name === "node_modules" || ent.name === ".git") continue;
00111:         stack.push(fp);
00112:       } else if (ent.isFile()) {
00113:         out.push(fp);
00114:         if (out.length >= maxFiles) return out;
00115:       }
00116:     }
00117:   }
00118: 
00119:   return out;

00001: "use strict";
00002: 
00003: const { getDb } = require("../service/firebaseAdmin");
00004: 
00005: function hh(v) {
00006:   const m = String(v || "").match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00007:   if (!m) return "";
00008:   const h = Number(m[1]);
00009:   if (!Number.isFinite(h) || h < 0 || h > 23) return "";
00010:   return `${String(h).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00011: }
00012: 
00013: (async () => {
00014:   const db = getDb();
00015:   const snap = await db.collection("draws")
00016:     .where("lottery_key", "==", "FEDERAL")
00017:     .select("ymd", "date", "close_hour", "close", "close_hour_raw")
00018:     .get();
00019: 
00020:   let first20 = null;
00021:   let last19 = null;
00022: 
00023:   for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00024:     const d = doc.data() || {};
00025:     const ymd = String(d.ymd || d.date || "").slice(0, 10);
00026:     const ch = hh(d.close_hour || d.close || d.close_hour_raw);
00027: 
00028:     if (ymd && ch === "20:00") {
00029:       if (!first20 || ymd < first20) first20 = ymd;
00030:     }
00031:     if (ymd && ch === "19:00") {
00032:       if (!last19 || ymd > last19) last19 = ymd;
00033:     }
00034:   }
00035: 
00036:   console.log(JSON.stringify({ first20, last19, total: snap.size }, null, 2));
00037: })();

00001: "use strict";

00005: function isISODate(s) {
00006:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00007:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00008:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00009:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00010:   return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === (m - 1) && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
00011: }
00012: 
00013: function uniq(arr) {
00014:   return Array.from(new Set(arr));
00015: }
00016: const DATE = String(process.argv[2] || "2026-01-28").trim();
00017: const ids = uniq(
00018:   String(process.argv[3] || "")
00019:     .split(",")
00020:     .map((s) => s.trim())
00021:     .filter(Boolean)
00022: );
00023: 
00024: if (!isISODate(DATE)) {
00025:   console.log("ERRO: data inválida. Use YYYY-MM-DD.");
00026:   process.exit(1);
00027: }
00028: if (!ids.length) {
00029:   console.log("Uso: node scripts/probeKingLotteryIds.js YYYY-MM-DD uuid1,uuid2,uuid3");
00030:   process.exit(1);
00031: }
00032: 
00033: async function main() {
00034:   const base = String(process.env.BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:3333").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
00035:   for (const id of ids) {
00036:   const url = `${base}/api/king/draws/day?date=${encodeURIComponent(DATE)}&lottery=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&includePrizes=0`;
00037: 
00038:   try {
00039:       const resp = await axios.get(url, {
00040:         headers: {
00041:           Accept: "application/json, text/plain, */*",
00042:         },
00043:         timeout: 20000,
00044:         validateStatus: () => true,
00045:       });

00150: function getPtRioSlotsByDate(ymd) {

00152:

00167:

00172:     return {
00173:       ok: true,
00174:       source: "fallback",

00176:       year: Number.isFinite(year) ? year : null,

00179:       opcional: ["09:00"],
00180:       rara: ["18:00", "21:00"],
00181:       note: "INVALID_YEAR_OR_DOW",
00182:     };
00183:   }
00184: 
00185:   const loaded = loadRules();
00186:   if (loaded.ok && loaded.map) {
00187:     const hit = loaded.map.get(`${year}:${dow}`);
00188:     if (hit) {
00189:       return {

00201:

00203:     ok: true,
00204:     source: "fallback",
00205:     date,

00207:     dow,
00208:     core: ["11:00", "14:00", "16:00"],

00012: function normHour(v) {
00013:   const m = String(v || "").match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00014:   if (!m) return "";
00015:   return String(Number(m[1])).padStart(2, "0") + ":00";
00016: }

00018: function unwrapDraws(payload) {
00019:   if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
00020:   if (Array.isArray(payload?.draws)) return payload.draws;
00021:   if (Array.isArray(payload?.results)) return payload.results;
00022:   if (Array.isArray(payload?.data)) return payload.data;
00023:   if (Array.isArray(payload?.data?.draws)) return payload.data.draws;
00024:   if (Array.isArray(payload?.data?.results)) return payload.data.results;
00025:   return [];
00026: }

00045: /**
00046:  * baseMins="0,9" -> [0,9]
00047:  */
00048: function parseBaseMins(raw, fallback = [9]) {
00049:   const s = String(raw || "").trim();
00050:   if (!s) return fallback;
00051:   const arr = s
00052:     .split(",")
00053:     .map((x) => Number(String(x || "").trim()))
00054:     .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 59);
00055:   return arr.length ? Array.from(new Set(arr)) : fallback;
00056: }
00057: 
00058: /**
00059:  * Normaliza hour vindo do plan:
00060:  * aceita "09", "9", "09:00", 9, etc -> "HH"
00061:  */
00062: function normalizeHH(raw) {
00063:   const s = safeStr(raw);
00064:   if (!s) return null;
00065:   const m = s.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00066:   if (!m) return null;
00067:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00068:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || hh < 0 || hh > 23) return null;
00069:   return pad2(hh);
00070: }
00071: 
00072: /**
00073:  * Gera candidatos de close_hour:
00074:  * - para cada baseMin (ex.: 0 e 9)
00075:  * - aplica deltas de 0..tol (ex.: tol=2 => 0, +1, +2, -1, -2)
00076:  * - mantém ordem: baseMin0 (0,+1,+2,-1,-2), depois baseMin9 (9,+1,+2,-1,-2)
00077:  */
00078: function closeCandidates(hh, baseMins = [9], tolMin = 2) {
00079:   const h = Number(hh);
00080:   const tol = Math.max(0, Number(tolMin) || 0);
00081:   const deltas = [0];
00082:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(+i);
00083:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(-i);
00084: 
00085:   const out = [];
00086:   for (const bm of baseMins) {
00087:     const base = Number(bm);
00088:     for (const d of deltas) {
00089:       const mm = base + d;
00090:       if (mm < 0 || mm > 59) continue;
00091:       out.push(`${pad2(h)}:${pad2(mm)}`);
00092:     }
00093:   }
00094:   return Array.from(new Set(out));
00095: }

00074: function normHHMM(value) {
00075:   const s = String(value || "").trim();
00076:   if (!s) return "";
00077: 
00078:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00079:   if (mh) return `${String(mh[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00080: 
00081:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00082:   if (mISO) {
00083:     const hh = String(mISO[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00084:     const mm = String(mISO[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00085:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00086:   }
00087: 
00088:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00089:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00090: 
00091:   return s;
00092: }

00130: function dedupeDrawsLogicalPreferBest(draws) {
00131:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00132:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00133: 
00134:   const byKey = new Map();
00135:   const order = [];
00136: 
00137:   const score = (d) => {
00138:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00139:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount)) ? Number(d.prizesCount) : 0;
00140:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawDateRaw(d));
00141:     const hhmm = normHHMM(getDrawHourRaw(d));
00142:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hhmm);
00143:     return prizesLen * 1000000 + pc * 1000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00144:   };
00145: 
00146:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00147:     const d = arr[i] || {};
00148:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawDateRaw(d)) || "";
00149:     const hhmm = normHHMM(getDrawHourRaw(d)) || "";
00150:     const lotteryCode = getDrawLotteryCodeRaw(d) || "";
00151: 
00152:     const id =
00153:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00154:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00155:       "";
00156: 
00157:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hhmm);
00158: 
00159:     const key = hasLogical
00160:       ? lotteryCode
00161:         ? `${ymd}__${hhmm}__${lotteryCode}`
00162:         : `${ymd}__${hhmm}`
00163:       : `id__${id || `idx_${i}`}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00166:       byKey.set(key, d);
00167:       order.push(key);
00168:       continue;
00169:     }
00170: 
00171:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00172:     if (score(d) > score(prev)) {
00173:       byKey.set(key, d);
00174:     }
00175:   }
00176: 
00177:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00178: }

00413:   let h = 0;

00424: export async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00425:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00426:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
00427:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00428: 
00429:   let idx = 0;
00430: 
00431:   async function worker() {
00432:     // ✅ claim seguro do próximo índice
00433:     // (evita disputa em cenários com yield/microtasks)
00434:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
00435:     while (true) {
00436:       const current = idx;
00437:       idx += 1;
00438:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00439:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00440:     }
00441:   }
00442: 
00443:   await Promise.all(
00444:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00445:   );
00446: 
00447:   return results;
00448: }

00122: function extractHourFromText(text) {
00123:   const s = String(text ?? "").trim();
00124:   if (!s) return "";
00125:   const mh = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\s*(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)\b/i);
00126:   if (mh) return `${pad2(mh[1])}:00`;
00127:   const mIso = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\b/);
00128:   if (mIso) return `${pad2(mIso[1])}:${pad2(mIso[2])}`;
00129:   const mBare = s.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})(?:\D|$)/);
00130:   if (mBare) {
00131:     const n = Number(mBare[1]);
00132:     if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 23) return `${pad2(n)}:00`;
00133:   }
00134:   return "";
00135: }

00413: function digitFromKey(key) {
00414:   const s = String(key || "");
00415:   let h = 0;
00416:   for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 1) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
00417:   return String(h % 10);
00418: }

00421: /* ========= utils: concorrência ========= */
00422: 
00423: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00424:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00425:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
00426:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00427:   let idx = 0;
00428: 
00429:   async function worker() {
00430:     while (idx < arr.length) {
00431:       const current = idx++;
00432:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00433:     }
00434:   }
00435: 
00436:   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker));
00437:   return results;
00438: }

00086: function normalizeHourLike(value) {

00106: function hourToMinutes(hhmm) {
00107:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
00108:   const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00109:   if (!m) return null;

00112:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;

00468: function dedupeDraws(list, scopeKey, ymd) {

00449:   return `ID:${scopeKey}|${ymd}|${id || "?"}`;
00450: }
00451: 
00452: function countPrizes(d) {
00453:   return Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00454: }
00455: 
00456: function pickBetterDraw(a, b) {
00457:   const pa = countPrizes(a);
00458:   const pb = countPrizes(b);
00459:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
00460: 
00461:   const ha = safeStr(a?.close_hour || a?.closeHour || a?.hour || a?.hora);
00462:   const hb = safeStr(b?.close_hour || b?.closeHour || b?.hour || b?.hora);
00463:   if (!!hb !== !!ha) return hb ? b : a;
00464: 
00465:   return a;
00466: }
00467: 
00468: function dedupeDraws(list, scopeKey, ymd) {
00469:   const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
00470:   const map = new Map();
00471: 
00472:   for (const d of arr) {
00473:     const k = drawKeyForDedup(d, scopeKey, ymd);
00474:     const prev = map.get(k);
00475:     if (!prev) map.set(k, d);
00476:     else map.set(k, pickBetterDraw(prev, d));
00477:   }
00478: 
00479:   return Array.from(map.values());
00480: }

00495:   if (!s) return "";

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036:   return base + add;
00037: }

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036:   return base + add;
00037: }

00043:   return `${y}|${h}`;

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036: 
00037:   return base + add;
00038: }
00039: 
00040: function drawKey(draw) {
00041:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00042:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00043:   if (!y || !h) return "";
00044:   return `${y}|${h}`;
00045: }
00046: 
00047: function dedupeAndSort(draws) {
00048:   const map = new Map();
00049: 
00050:   for (const d of Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []) {
00051:     const key = drawKey(d);
00052:     if (!key) continue;
00053:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, d);
00054:   }
00055: 
00056:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawTs(a) - drawTs(b));
00057: }
00058: 
00059: function top5Groups(draw) {
00060:   const out = [];
00061: 
00062:   for (const p of Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : []) {
00063:     const pos = Number(guessPrizePos(p));
00064:     const g = Number(guessPrizeGrupo(p));
00065: 
00066:     if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 5) continue;
00067:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) continue;
00068: 
00069:     out.push({ pos, grupo: g });
00070:   }
00071: 
00072:   return out.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
00073: }

00075: function pct(n, d) {
00076:   return d ? ((n / d) * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
00077: }

00079: function ensureHourRow(map, hour) {
00080:   const key = toHourBucket(hour || "") || "SEM_HORA";
00081: 
00082:   if (!map.has(key)) {
00083:     map.set(key, { total: 0, hitTop5: 0, hitFirst: 0 });
00084:   }
00085: 
00086:   return map.get(key);
00087: }

00089: function assertComputedSlotMatchesNextDraw({ computed, found, nextSlot, drawLast }) {

00091:   const computedNextHour = toHourBucket(computed?.meta?.next?.hour || "");

00094:   const expectedHour = toHourBucket(
00095:     found?.hour || found?.slot?.hour || nextSlot?.hour || ""
00096:   );

00100:       [

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036: 
00037:   return base + add;
00038: }

00042: function firstFiniteNumber(...values) {
00043:   for (const v of values) {
00044:     const n = Number(v);

00051: function sanitizeTop3(top) {
00052:   const out = [];
00053:   const seen = new Set();
00054: 
00055:   for (const item of Array.isArray(top) ? top : []) {
00056:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
00057: 
00058:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) continue;
00059: 
00060:     const grupo = Math.trunc(g);
00061:     if (seen.has(grupo)) continue;
00062: 
00063:     const confidence = firstFiniteNumber(
00064:       item?.displayConfidence,
00065:       item?.confidence,
00066:       item?.scoreProb,
00067:       item?.prob,
00068:       0
00069:     );
00070: 
00071:     if (!Number.isFinite(confidence) || confidence < 0) continue;
00072: 
00073:     seen.add(grupo);
00074: 
00075:     out.push({
00076:       ...item,
00077:       grupo,
00078:       displayConfidence: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.displayConfidence))
00079:         ? Number(item.displayConfidence)
00080:         : confidence,
00081:       confidence: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.confidence))
00082:         ? Number(item.confidence)
00083:         : confidence,
00084:       scoreProb: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.scoreProb))
00085:         ? Number(item.scoreProb)
00086:         : confidence,
00087:     });
00088: 
00089:     if (out.length >= 3) break;
00090:   }
00091: 
00092:   return out;
00093: }

00020: function safeInt(v, fallback = 0) {
00021:   const n = Number(v);
00022:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
00023: }
00024: 
00025: function drawSortTs(draw) {
00026:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00027:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00028: 
00029:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00030: 
00031:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00032:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00033: 
00034:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00035:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00036: 
00037:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00038: }
00039: 
00040: function slotTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00041:   const safeYmd = String(ymd || "").trim();
00042:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00043: 
00044:   if (!isYMD(safeYmd) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00045: 
00046:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00048: 
00049:   const [Y, M, D] = safeYmd.split("-").map(Number);
00050:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00051: 
00052:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00053: }

00055: function dedupeAndSortDraws(draws) {
00056:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00057:   const map = new Map();
00058: 
00059:   for (const d of list) {
00060:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00061:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00062:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00063: 
00064:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
00065: 
00066:     const key =
00067:       String(d?.id || d?.drawId || "").trim() ||
00068:       (isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "");
00069: 
00070:     if (!key) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const prev = map.get(key);
00073: 
00074:     if (!prev || ts < drawSortTs(prev)) {
00075:       map.set(key, d);
00076:     }
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawSortTs(a) - drawSortTs(b));
00080: }

00082: function makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour) {
00083:   const from = toHourBucket(fromHour);
00084:   const to = toHourBucket(toHour);
00085: 
00086:   if (!from || !to) return "";
00087: 
00088:   return `${from}->${to}`;
00089: }

00091: function getNestedMap(map, key) {
00092:   if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, new Map());
00093:   return map.get(key);
00094: }

00102:   return list.filter((d) => {
00103:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00104:     return Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < target;

00110:   const transitionsAny = new Map();
00111:   const transitionsByEdge = new Map();

00113:   for (let i = 0; i < list.length - 1; i += 1) {

00115:     const toDraw = list[i + 1];

00119:     const fromHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(fromDraw));
00120:     const toHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(toDraw));
00121:

00123:     if (fromGrupo < 1 || fromGrupo > 25) continue;
00124:     if (toGrupo < 1 || toGrupo > 25) continue;

00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00048: 
00049:   const [Y, M, D] = safeYmd.split("-").map(Number);
00050:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00051: 
00052:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00053: }

00055: function dedupeAndSortDraws(draws) {
00056:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];

00060:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);

00067:       String(d?.id || d?.drawId || "").trim() ||
00068:       (isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "");

00075:       map.set(key, d);
00076:     }

00109:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00110:   const transitionsAny = new Map();
00111:   const transitionsByEdge = new Map();

00124:     if (toGrupo < 1 || toGrupo > 25) continue;

00195: function ymdHourToTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00196:   const y = safeStr(ymd);
00197:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00198: 
00199:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00200: 
00201:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00208: 
00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00210: }

00590:         continue;

00689: ) {

00691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
00692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
00693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00694: 
00695:   const freq = new Map();

00996:     firstFreq: new Map(),

01014:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01015:     });

01025:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,

01040:     };
01041: 
01042:     const nextMaps = buildFreqAndFirstMaps(nextDraw);

01045:       const layer = layers[i];

01051:       mergeMapsAdd(layerResults[i].firstFreq, nextMaps.firstMap);
01052:     }
01053:   }

01055:   let chosen =
01056:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples >= x.minSamples && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01057:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples > 0 && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01058:     null;

01064:       minSamples: 0,

01066:       freq: new Map(),
01067:       firstFreq: new Map(),
01068:       matchingDraws: [],
01069:     };
01070:   }
01071:

01073:     chosen,
01074:     layers: layerResults,

01464:

01445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
01446:   draws,
01447:   lotteryKey,
01448:   targetHour,
01449:   targetDow,
01450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01451: ) {
01452:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01456: 
01457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01458:   let totalSamples = 0;
01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {
01461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
01464: 
01465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
01467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471: 
01472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
01474: 
01475:     totalSamples += 1;
01476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
01477:   }
01478: 
01479:   const prob = new Map();
01480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01481: 
01482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01484:   }
01485: 
01486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
01487: }

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;

01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);

01599: 
01600:   let totalWeight = 0;
01601:   let matchedSamples = 0;
01602: 
01603:   for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
01604:     const target = seq[i];
01605:     const histState = [];
01606: 
01607:     for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && histState.length < 3; j -= 1) {
01608:       histState.push(Number(seq[j].grupo));
01609:     }
01610: 
01611:     const matchDepth = countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState);
01612:     if (matchDepth <= 0) continue;
01613: 
01614:     const weight =
01615:       matchDepth >= 3 ? 4.0 :
01616:       matchDepth === 2 ? 2.5 :
01617:       1.0;
01618: 
01619:     const g = Number(target.grupo);
01620:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01621: 
01622:     freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
01623:     totalWeight += weight;
01624:     matchedSamples += 1;
01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,
01639:     state: Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [],
01640:     sequenceSamples: seq.length,
01641:   };
01642: }

01644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
01645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
01646:   const groups = list
01647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
01648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
01649: 
01650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
01651:     return {
01652:       regime: "neutral",
01653:       repeatRate: 0,
01654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
01655:       samples: groups.length,
01656:     };
01657:   }
01658: 
01659:   let repeats = 0;
01660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
01661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
01662:   }
01663: 
01664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
01665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
01666: 
01667:   let regime = "neutral";
01668: 
01669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
01670:     regime = "repeat";
01671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
01672:     regime = "spread";
01673:   }
01674: 
01675:   return {
01676:     regime,
01677:     repeatRate,
01678:     uniqueRate,
01679:     samples: groups.length,
01680:   };
01681: }

01728: function computeComparableDuplicationDistribution(
01729:   draws,
01730:   lotteryKey,
01731:   targetHour,
01732:   targetDow,
01733:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01734: ) {
01735:   const list = getComparableDrawsForTargetContext(
01736:     draws,
01737:     lotteryKey,
01738:     targetHour,
01739:     targetDow
01740:   );
01741: 
01742:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01743:   const freq = new Map();
01744:   let totalSamples = 0;
01745: 
01746:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01747:     freq.set(g, 0);
01748:   }
01749: 
01750:   for (const d of list) {
01751:     const counts = countAparicoesByGrupoInDraw(d);
01752:     if (!counts.size) continue;
01753: 
01754:     totalSamples += 1;
01755: 
01756:     for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01757:       const c = Number(counts.get(g) || 0);
01758:       if (c >= 2) {
01759:         freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
01760:       }
01761:     }
01762:   }
01763: 
01764:   const prob = new Map();
01765:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01766: 
01767:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01768:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01769:   }
01770: 
01771:   return { prob, freq, totalSamples };
01772: }

01792: function computeRecentBichoMetrics(draws, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
01793:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);

01799:       recentFirst: 0,
01800:       recentDupDraws: 0,
01801:       recentLast1Top5: 0,
01802:       recentLast2Top5: 0,
01803:       recentLast3Top5: 0,
01804:     });

01806: 
01807:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01808:   const last1 = list.length ? [list[list.length - 1]] : [];
01809:   const last2 = list.slice(-2);
01810:   const last3 = list.slice(-3);
01811: 
01812:   for (const d of list) {
01813:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
01814:     const perDrawCounts = new Map();
01815: 
01816:     for (const it of items) {
01817:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01818:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01819: 
01820:       const row = out.get(g);
01821:       row.recentTop5 += 1;
01822: 
01823:       if (Number(it.pos) === 1) {
01824:         row.recentFirst += 1;
01825:       }
01826: 
01827:       perDrawCounts.set(g, Number(perDrawCounts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
01828:     }
01829: 
01830:     for (const [g, c] of perDrawCounts.entries()) {
01831:       if (Number(c) >= 2) {
01832:         out.get(Number(g)).recentDupDraws += 1;
01833:       }
01834:     }
01835:   }
01836:

01839:     for (const it of getAllTop5Groups(d)) {

01841:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01842:       seen.add(g);
01843:       out.get(g).recentLast1Top5 += 1;
01844:     }
01845:   }
01846:

01848:     const seen = new Set();
01849:     for (const it of getAllTop5Groups(d)) {

01851:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01852:       seen.add(g);
01853:       out.get(g).recentLast2Top5 += 1;
01854:     }
01855:   }
01856:

01858:     const seen = new Set();
01859:     for (const it of getAllTop5Groups(d)) {
01860:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01861:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01862:       seen.add(g);

01935: function computeComparableLastSeenByGrupo(

01938:   targetHour,
01939:   targetDow,
01940:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K

01949:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);

01951: 
01952:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01953:     last.set(g, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
01954:   }
01955: 
01956:   for (const d of list) {
01957:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01958:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01959:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
01960:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
01961: 
01962:     for (const it of items) {
01963:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01964:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01965: 
01966:       const prev = Number(last.get(g));
01967:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
01968:         last.set(g, ts);
01969:       }
01970:     }
01971:   }
01972: 
01973:   return last;

01976: function buildDayContext(drawsToday = []) {
01977:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(Array.isArray(drawsToday) ? drawsToday : []);
01978:   const freq = new Map();
01979:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01980:   const seq = [];
01981: 
01982:   for (const d of list) {
01983:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01984:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > 25) continue;
01985: 
01986:     const gg = Number(g);
01987:     seq.push(gg);
01988:     freq.set(gg, Number(freq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01989: 
01990:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
01991:     if (items.some((it) => Number(it.grupo) === gg && Number(it.pos) === 1)) {
01992:       firstFreq.set(gg, Number(firstFreq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01993:     }
01994:   }
01995: 
01996:   const total = seq.length;
01997:   const unique = new Set(seq).size;
01998:   const diversidade = total > 0 ? unique / total : 0;
01999: 
02000:   let dominante = null;
02001:   let dominanteCount = -1;
02002:   for (const [g, n] of freq.entries()) {
02003:     if (Number(n) > dominanteCount) {
02004:       dominante = Number(g);
02005:       dominanteCount = Number(n);
02006:     }
02007:   }
02008: 
02009:   const last1 = total >= 1 ? seq[total - 1] : null;
02010:   const last2 = total >= 2 ? seq[total - 2] : null;
02011:   const repeatNow =
02012:     Number.isFinite(Number(last1)) &&
02013:     Number.isFinite(Number(last2)) &&
02014:     Number(last1) === Number(last2);
02015: 
02016:   return {
02017:     total,
02018:     unique,
02019:     diversidade,
02020:     dominante,
02021:     dominanteCount: Math.max(0, dominanteCount),
02022:     repeatNow,
02023:     freq,
02024:     firstFreq,

01949:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01950:   const last = new Map();
01951: 
01952:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01953:     last.set(g, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
01954:   }
01955: 
01956:   for (const d of list) {
01957:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);

01961:

01963:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01964:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01965: 
01966:       const prev = Number(last.get(g));
01967:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
01968:         last.set(g, ts);
01969:       }
01970:     }
01971:   }
01972: 
01973:   return last;

02118: ) {
02119:   const seq = Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [];
02120:   const state = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
02121:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02122: 
02123:   const freq = new Map();
02124:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
02125:

02127:     const prob = new Map();
02128:     for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) prob.set(g, 0);
02129:     return { prob, freq, samples: 0, prev2: null, prev1: null };
02130:   }
02131: 
02132:   const prev1 = Number(state[0]);
02133:   const prev2 = Number(state[1]);

02136: 
02137:   for (let i = 2; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
02138:     const gA = Number(seq[i - 2]?.grupo);
02139:     const gB = Number(seq[i - 1]?.grupo);
02140:     const gN = Number(seq[i]?.grupo);
02141: 
02142:     if (!Number.isFinite(gA) || !Number.isFinite(gB) || !Number.isFinite(gN)) continue;
02143:     if (gA !== prev2 || gB !== prev1) continue;
02144:     if (gN < 1 || gN > k) continue;
02145: 
02146:     samples += 1;
02147:     freq.set(gN, Number(freq.get(gN) || 0) + 1);
02148:   }
02149: 
02150:   const prob = new Map();
02151:   const denom = Math.max(1, samples);
02152: 
02153:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02154:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
02155:   }

02160: function buildRecentRepeatBoostMap(
02161:   comparableSeq,
02162:   targetTs,
02163:   windowSize = 4,
02164:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
02165: ) {
02166:   const seq = getComparableRecentDrawsBeforeTs(
02167:     Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [],
02168:     targetTs,
02169:     windowSize
02170:   );
02171: 
02172:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02173:   const counts = new Map();
02174:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) counts.set(g, 0);
02175: 
02176:   for (const item of seq) {
02177:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
02178:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
02179:     counts.set(g, Number(counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
02180:   }
02181: 
02182:   const boost = new Map();
02183:   const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...Array.from(counts.values()).map((n) => Number(n || 0)));
02184: 
02185:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02186:     const c = Number(counts.get(g) || 0);
02187:     boost.set(g, c >= 2 ? c / maxCount : 0);
02188:   }
02189: 
02190:   return {
02191:     boost,
02192:     counts,
02193:     windowSize,
02194:     considered: Array.isArray(seq) ? seq.length : 0,
02195:   };
02196: }

02838: 
02839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
02840:   const k = Number(key);
02841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
02842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
02843: }
02844: 
02845: function emptyGroupMap() {
02846:   const out = new Map();
02847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
02848:   return out;
02849: }
02850: 
02851: function getTop5GroupSet(draw) {
02852:   return new Set(
02853:     getAllTop5Groups(draw)
02854:       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
02855:       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)
02856:   );
02857: }
02858: 
02859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
02860:   const out = new Map();
02861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
02862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
02863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
02864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
02865: 
02866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
02868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
02869:   }
02870: 
02871:   return out;
02872: }
02873: 
02874: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
02875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
02876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
02877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
02878: }

03263: function sceneGrupoFromMilhar4(m4) {
03264:   const s = String(m4 || "").replace(/\D+/g, "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4);
03265:   if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(s)) return null;
03266: 
03267:   const dzRaw = Number(s.slice(-2));
03268:   if (!Number.isFinite(dzRaw)) return null;
03269: 
03270:   const dz = dzRaw === 0 ? 100 : dzRaw;
03271:   const grupo = Math.ceil(dz / 4);
03272: 
03273:   return grupo >= 1 && grupo <= 25 ? grupo : null;
03274: }
03275: 
03276: function buildSceneFromDraw(draw) {
03277:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
03278: 
03279:   const rows = prizes
03280:     .map((p) => {
03281:       const pos = Number(guessPrizePos(p));
03282:       const milhar = scenePickMilhar4(p);
03283:       const grupo = sceneGrupoFromMilhar4(milhar);
03284: 
03285:       return {
03286:         pos,
03287:         milhar: String(milhar || "").replace(/\D+/g, "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4),
03288:         centena: getCentena3(milhar),
03289:         dezena: getDezena2(milhar),
03290:         grupo,
03291:       };
03292:     })
03293:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.pos) && x.pos >= 1 && x.pos <= 7)
03294:     .sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
03295: 
03296:   const grupos = rows.map((x) => x.grupo).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x));

03437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
03438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
03439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
03440: 
03441:   const freq = new Map();
03442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
03443: 
03444:   let totalWeight = 0;
03445: 
03446:   for (const item of ranking) {
03447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
03448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
03449: 
03450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
03451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
03452: 
03453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
03454:     totalWeight += score;
03455:   }
03456: 
03457:   const prob = new Map();
03458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
03459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
03460:   }
03461: 
03462:   return {
03463:     freq,
03464:     prob,
03465:     samples: ranking.length,
03466:     totalWeight,
03467:   };
03468: }

03437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
03438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
03439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
03440: 
03441:   const freq = new Map();
03442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
03443: 
03444:   let totalWeight = 0;
03445: 
03446:   for (const item of ranking) {
03447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
03448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
03449: 
03450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
03451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
03452: 
03453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
03454:     totalWeight += score;
03455:   }
03456: 
03457:   const prob = new Map();
03458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
03459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
03460:   }
03461: 
03462:   return {
03463:     freq,
03464:     prob,
03465:     samples: ranking.length,
03466:     totalWeight,
03467:   };

03840: export function auditTop3Timeline({
03841:   timeline,
03842:   lotteryKey = "",
03843: }) {
03844:   const rows = Array.isArray(timeline) ? timeline : [];
03845: 
03846:   const validated = rows.filter((slot) => {
03847:     const status = String(slot?.status || "").toLowerCase();

--- CONTEXTO LINHA 3872 ---
03832: }
03833: 
03834: /* =========================
03835:    TIMELINE DO DIA (CADEIA PREDITIVA)
03836: ========================= */
03837: 
03838: 
03839: 
03840: export function auditTop3Timeline({
03841:   timeline,
03842:   lotteryKey = "",
03843: }) {
03844:   const rows = Array.isArray(timeline) ? timeline : [];
03845: 
03846:   const validated = rows.filter((slot) => {
03847:     const status = String(slot?.status || "").toLowerCase();
03848:     return status === "validated" && Number.isFinite(Number(slot?.resultGrupo));
03849:   });
03850: 
03851:   const total = validated.length;
03852: 
03853:   const top1Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03854:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03855:     const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03856:     return Number.isFinite(first) && first === result;
03857:   }).length;
03858: 
03859:   const top3Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03860:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03861:     return (Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03862:       .slice(0, 3)
03863:       .some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result);
03864:   }).length;
03865: 
03866:   function pct(n, d) {
03867:     if (!d) return 0;
03868:     return Number(((Number(n || 0) / Number(d || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));
03869:   }
03870: 
03871:   function groupBy(keyFn) {
03872:     const map = new Map();
03873: 
03874:     for (const slot of validated) {
03875:       const key = keyFn(slot);
03876:       const current = map.get(key) || {
03877:         key,
03878:         total: 0,
03879:         top1Hits: 0,
03880:         top3Hits: 0,
03881:       };
03882: 
03883:       const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03884:       const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03885:       const picks = Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3.slice(0, 3) : [];
03886: 
03887:       current.total += 1;
03888:       if (Number.isFinite(first) && first === result) current.top1Hits += 1;
03889:       if (picks.some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result)) current.top3Hits += 1;
03890: 
03891:       map.set(key, current);
03892:     }
03893: 
03894:     return Array.from(map.values())
03895:       .map((x) => ({
03896:         ...x,
03897:         top1Rate: pct(x.top1Hits, x.total),
03898:         top3Rate: pct(x.top3Hits, x.total),
03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;
03903:       });
03904:   }
03905: 
03906:   return {
03907:     lotteryKey,
03908:     total,
03909:     top1Hits,
03910:     top3Hits,
03911:     top1Rate: pct(top1Hits, total),
03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),
03915:     rows: validated.map((slot) => ({

03840: export function auditTop3Timeline({
03841:   timeline,
03842:   lotteryKey = "",
03843: }) {
03844:   const rows = Array.isArray(timeline) ? timeline : [];
03845: 
03846:   const validated = rows.filter((slot) => {
03847:     const status = String(slot?.status || "").toLowerCase();
03848:     return status === "validated" && Number.isFinite(Number(slot?.resultGrupo));
03849:   });
03850: 
03851:   const total = validated.length;
03852: 
03853:   const top1Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03854:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03855:     const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03856:     return Number.isFinite(first) && first === result;
03857:   }).length;
03858: 
03859:   const top3Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03860:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03861:     return (Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03862:       .slice(0, 3)
03863:       .some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result);
03864:   }).length;
03865: 
03866:   function pct(n, d) {
03867:     if (!d) return 0;
03868:     return Number(((Number(n || 0) / Number(d || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));
03869:   }
03870: 
03871:   function groupBy(keyFn) {
03872:     const map = new Map();
03873: 
03874:     for (const slot of validated) {
03875:       const key = keyFn(slot);
03876:       const current = map.get(key) || {
03877:         key,
03878:         total: 0,
03879:         top1Hits: 0,
03880:         top3Hits: 0,
03881:       };
03882: 
03883:       const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03884:       const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03885:       const picks = Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3.slice(0, 3) : [];
03886: 
03887:       current.total += 1;
03888:       if (Number.isFinite(first) && first === result) current.top1Hits += 1;
03889:       if (picks.some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result)) current.top3Hits += 1;
03890: 
03891:       map.set(key, current);
03892:     }
03893: 
03894:     return Array.from(map.values())
03895:       .map((x) => ({
03896:         ...x,
03897:         top1Rate: pct(x.top1Hits, x.total),
03898:         top3Rate: pct(x.top3Hits, x.total),
03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;
03903:       });
03904:   }
03905: 
03906:   return {
03907:     lotteryKey,
03908:     total,
03909:     top1Hits,
03910:     top3Hits,
03911:     top1Rate: pct(top1Hits, total),
03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),
03915:     rows: validated.map((slot) => ({
03916:       ymd: slot.targetYmd,
03917:       hour: slot.targetHour,
03918:       baseYmd: slot.baseYmd,
03919:       baseHour: slot.baseHour,
03920:       resultGrupo: slot.resultGrupo,
03921:       top3: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03922:         .slice(0, 3)
03923:         .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo)),
03924:       top1Hit:
03925:         Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo),
03926:       top3Hit: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03927:         .slice(0, 3)
03928:         .some((x) => Number(x?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo)),
03929:     })),
03930:   };
03931: }

00195: function ymdHourToTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00196:   const y = safeStr(ymd);
00197:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00198: 
00199:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00200: 
00201:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00208: 
00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00210: }

00548: export function indexDrawsByYmdHour(draws) {
00549:   const map = new Map();
00550:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00551: 
00552:   for (const d of list) {
00553:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00554:     const rawH = pickDrawHour(d);
00555:     const h = toHourBucket(rawH);
00556: 
00557:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
00558: 
00559:     const drawKey = `${y}|${h}`;
00560:     const prev = map.get(drawKey);
00561: 
00562:     if (!prev) {
00563:       map.set(drawKey, d);
00564:       continue;
00565:     }
00566: 
00567:     if (drawQualityScore(d) >= drawQualityScore(prev)) {
00568:       map.set(drawKey, d);
00569:     }
00570:   }
00571: 
00572:   return map;
00573: }

00575: export function computeLastSeenByGrupo(draws) {
00576:   const last = new Map();
00577:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00578: 
00579:   for (const d of list) {
00580:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00581:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00582:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
00583: 
00584:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
00585:     const ps = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00586: 
00587:     for (const p of ps) {
00588:       const pos = guessPrizePos(p);
00589:       if (!Number.isFinite(Number(pos)) || Number(pos) < 1 || Number(pos) > 5) {
00590:         continue;
00591:       }
00592: 
00593:       const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p);
00594:       if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) <= 0) continue;
00595: 
00596:       const gg = Number(g);
00597:       const prev = last.get(gg);
00598: 
00599:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
00600:         last.set(gg, ts);
00601:       }
00602:     }
00603:   }
00604: 
00605:   return last;

00683: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
00684:   draws,
00685:   lotteryKey,
00686:   targetHour,
00687:   targetDow,
00688:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
00689: ) {
00690:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
00692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
00693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00694: 
00695:   const freq = new Map();
00696:   let totalSamples = 0;
00697: 
00698:   for (const d of list) {
00699:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00700:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00701:     if (!h || !y) continue;
00702: 
00703:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
00704:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
00705:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
00706:     } else {
00707:       if (h !== target) continue;
00708:     }
00709: 
00710:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00711:     if (!items.length) continue;
00712: 
00713:     totalSamples += 1;
00714: 
00715:     for (const it of items) {
00716:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00717:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00718:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00719:     }
00720:   }
00721: 
00722:   const out = new Map();
00723:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
00724: 
00725:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00726:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
00727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
00728:   }
00729: 
00730:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
00731: }

00827: function normalizeMetric(value, maxValue) {
00828:   const v = Number(value || 0);
00829:   const m = Number(maxValue || 0);
00830:   if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isFinite(m) || m <= 0) return 0;
00831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / m));
00832: }

00837:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));

00830:   if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isFinite(m) || m <= 0) return 0;
00831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / m));
00832: }
00833: 
00834: function clamp01(v) {
00835:   const n = Number(v);
00836:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
00837:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
00838: }

00840: function buildZeroProbMap(groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
00841:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00842:   return new Map(Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => [i + 1, 0]));
00843: }

00845: function confidenceFromSamples(samples, fullConfidenceAt = 8) {
00846:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
00847:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullConfidenceAt || 8));
00848:   return clamp01(n / lim);
00849: }

00966: function buildConditionalLayerDistribution({
00967:   lotteryKey,
00968:   drawsRange,
00969:   targetHour,
00970:   targetDow,
00971:   targetDayOfMonth,
00972:   prevHour,
00973:   prevGrupo,
00974:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00975:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00976:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00977: }) {

00979:   const drawsIndex = indexDrawsByYmdHour(list);
00980: 
00981:   const layers = buildLayerConfigs({
00982:     lotteryKey,

00984:     targetDow,
00985:     prevHour,
00986:     prevGrupo,
00987:     targetHour,

00991:     key: layer.key,
00992:     label: layer.label,
00993:     minSamples: layer.minSamples,
00994:     samples: 0,
00995:     freq: new Map(),
00996:     firstFreq: new Map(),
00997:     matchingDraws: [],
00998:   }));
00999: 
01000:   for (const d of list) {
01001:     const prevY = pickDrawYMD(d);
01002:     const prevH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01003:     if (!isYMD(prevY) || !prevH) continue;
01004: 
01005:     const prevG = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01006:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(prevG)) || Number(prevG) <= 0) continue;
01007: 
01008:     const ns = getNextSlotForLottery({
01009:       lotteryKey,
01010:       ymd: prevY,
01011:       hourBucket: prevH,
01012:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01013:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01014:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01015:     });
01016: 
01017:     if (!ns?.ymd || !ns?.hour) continue;
01018: 
01019:     const found = findNextExistingDrawFromSlot({
01020:       lotteryKey,
01021:       startSlot: { ymd: ns.ymd, hour: ns.hour },
01022:       drawsIndex,
01023:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01024:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01025:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01026:     });
01027: 
01028:     const nextDraw = found?.draw || null;
01029:     const nextSlot = found?.slot || null;
01030:     if (!nextDraw || !nextSlot?.ymd || !nextSlot?.hour) continue;
01031: 
01032:     const ctx = {
01033:       prevYmd: prevY,
01034:       prevHour: prevH,
01035:       prevGrupo: Number(prevG),
01036:       targetYmd: safeStr(nextSlot.ymd),
01037:       targetHour: toHourBucket(nextSlot.hour),
01038:       targetDow: getDowKey(nextSlot.ymd),
01039:       targetDayOfMonth: getDayOfMonth(nextSlot.ymd),
01040:     };
01041: 
01042:     const nextMaps = buildFreqAndFirstMaps(nextDraw);
01043: 
01044:     for (let i = 0; i < layers.length; i += 1) {
01045:       const layer = layers[i];
01046:       if (!layer.match(ctx)) continue;
01047: 
01048:       layerResults[i].samples += 1;
01049:       layerResults[i].matchingDraws.push(nextDraw);
01050:       mergeMapsAdd(layerResults[i].freq, nextMaps.freq);
01051:       mergeMapsAdd(layerResults[i].firstFreq, nextMaps.firstMap);
01052:     }
01053:   }
01054: 
01055:   let chosen =
01056:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples >= x.minSamples && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01057:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples > 0 && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01058:     null;
01059: 
01060:   if (!chosen) {
01061:     chosen = {
01062:       key: "NONE",
01063:       label: "sem amostra",
01064:       minSamples: 0,
01065:       samples: 0,
01066:       freq: new Map(),
01067:       firstFreq: new Map(),
01068:       matchingDraws: [],
01069:     };
01070:   }
01071: 
01072:   return {
01073:     chosen,
01074:     layers: layerResults,
01075:   };

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

01578: function buildMemoryStateDistribution({
01579:   drawsRange,
01580:   lotteryKey,
01581:   targetHour,
01582:   targetDow,
01583:   currentState,
01584:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K,
01585: }) {
01586:   const seq = buildComparableFirstSequence(
01587:     drawsRange,
01588:     lotteryKey,
01589:     targetHour,
01590:     targetDow
01591:   );
01592: 
01593:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01594:   const freq = new Map();
01595: 
01596:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01597:     freq.set(g, 0);
01598:   }
01599: 
01600:   let totalWeight = 0;
01601:   let matchedSamples = 0;
01602: 
01603:   for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
01604:     const target = seq[i];
01605:     const histState = [];
01606: 
01607:     for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && histState.length < 3; j -= 1) {
01608:       histState.push(Number(seq[j].grupo));
01609:     }
01610: 
01611:     const matchDepth = countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState);
01612:     if (matchDepth <= 0) continue;
01613: 
01614:     const weight =
01615:       matchDepth >= 3 ? 4.0 :
01616:       matchDepth === 2 ? 2.5 :
01617:       1.0;
01618: 
01619:     const g = Number(target.grupo);
01620:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01621: 
01622:     freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
01623:     totalWeight += weight;
01624:     matchedSamples += 1;
01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,
01639:     state: Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [],
01640:     sequenceSamples: seq.length,
01641:   };
01642: }

01644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
01645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
01646:   const groups = list
01647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
01648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
01649: 
01650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
01651:     return {
01652:       regime: "neutral",
01653:       repeatRate: 0,
01654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
01655:       samples: groups.length,
01656:     };
01657:   }
01658: 
01659:   let repeats = 0;
01660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
01661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
01662:   }
01663: 
01664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
01665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
01666: 
01667:   let regime = "neutral";
01668: 
01669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
01670:     regime = "repeat";
01671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
01672:     regime = "spread";
01673:   }

02167:     Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [],
02168:     targetTs,
02169:     windowSize
02170:   );
02171: 
02172:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02173:   const counts = new Map();

02179:     counts.set(g, Number(counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
02180:   }

02183:   const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...Array.from(counts.values()).map((n) => Number(n || 0)));

02191:     boost,
02192:     counts,
02193:     windowSize,

02195:   };

02839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
02840:   const k = Number(key);
02841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
02842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
02843: }
02844: 
02845: function emptyGroupMap() {
02846:   const out = new Map();
02847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
02848:   return out;
02849: }
02850: 
02851: function getTop5GroupSet(draw) {
02852:   return new Set(
02853:     getAllTop5Groups(draw)
02854:       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
02855:       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)
02856:   );
02857: }
02858: 
02859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
02860:   const out = new Map();
02861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
02862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
02863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
02864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
02865: 
02866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
02868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
02869:   }
02870: 
02871:   return out;
02872: }

02875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
02876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
02877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
02878: }

02835: /* =========================
02836:    Motor principal V3 (ESTATISTICO AUDITAVEL)
02837: ========================= */
02838: 
02839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
02840:   const k = Number(key);
02841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
02842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
02843: }
02844: 
02845: function emptyGroupMap() {
02846:   const out = new Map();
02847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
02848:   return out;
02849: }
02850: 
02851: function getTop5GroupSet(draw) {
02852:   return new Set(
02853:     getAllTop5Groups(draw)
02854:       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
02855:       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)
02856:   );
02857: }
02858: 
02859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
02860:   const out = new Map();
02861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
02862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
02863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
02864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
02865: 
02866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
02868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
02869:   }
02870: 
02871:   return out;
02872: }
02873: 
02874: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
02875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
02876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
02877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
02878: }

03306:       .map(([value, count]) => ({ value, count }));

03437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
03438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
03439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
03440: 
03441:   const freq = new Map();
03442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
03443: 
03444:   let totalWeight = 0;
03445: 
03446:   for (const item of ranking) {
03447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
03448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
03449: 
03450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
03451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
03452: 
03453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
03454:     totalWeight += score;
03455:   }
03456: 
03457:   const prob = new Map();
03458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
03459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
03460:   }
03461: 
03462:   return {
03463:     freq,
03464:     prob,
03465:     samples: ranking.length,
03466:     totalWeight,
03467:   };
03468: }

03845:

03852:

03856:     return Number.isFinite(first) && first === result;
03857:   }).length;
03858:

03860:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03861:     return (Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03862:       .slice(0, 3)
03863:       .some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result);

03865: 
03866:   function pct(n, d) {
03867:     if (!d) return 0;
03868:     return Number(((Number(n || 0) / Number(d || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));
03869:   }

03871:   function groupBy(keyFn) {
03872:     const map = new Map();
03873: 
03874:     for (const slot of validated) {
03875:       const key = keyFn(slot);
03876:       const current = map.get(key) || {
03877:         key,
03878:         total: 0,
03879:         top1Hits: 0,
03880:         top3Hits: 0,
03881:       };
03882:

03890:

03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;

03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),

03896:         ...x,
03897:         top1Rate: pct(x.top1Hits, x.total),
03898:         top3Rate: pct(x.top3Hits, x.total),
03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;
03903:       });
03904:   }
03905: 
03906:   return {
03907:     lotteryKey,
03908:     total,
03909:     top1Hits,
03910:     top3Hits,
03911:     top1Rate: pct(top1Hits, total),
03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),
03915:     rows: validated.map((slot) => ({
03916:       ymd: slot.targetYmd,
03917:       hour: slot.targetHour,
03918:       baseYmd: slot.baseYmd,
03919:       baseHour: slot.baseHour,
03920:       resultGrupo: slot.resultGrupo,
03921:       top3: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03922:         .slice(0, 3)
03923:         .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo)),
03924:       top1Hit:
03925:         Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo),
03926:       top3Hit: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03927:         .slice(0, 3)
03928:         .some((x) => Number(x?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo)),
03929:     })),
03930:   };
03931: }

00197:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00198: 
00199:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00200: 
00201:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00208: 
00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00210: }

00261: export function findLastDrawInList(draws, schedule) {

00269:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(pickDrawYMD(b), toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(b)));
00270:       return tb - ta;
00271:     });
00272: 
00273:   return sorted[0] || null;

00277:   draws,
00278:   targetHourBucket,
00279:   schedule
00280: ) {
00281:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];

00283:

00285:   if (t < 0) return null;

00288:     .filter((d) => isHourInSchedule(schedule, pickDrawHour(d)))
00289:     .map((d) => ({ d, h: hourToInt(toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d))) }))
00290:     .filter((x) => x.h >= 0 && x.h < t)
00291:     .sort((a, b) => b.h - a.h);
00292: 
00293:   return candidates.length ? candidates[0].d : null;
00294: }

00590:         continue;
00591:       }
00592: 
00593:       const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p);
00594:       if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) <= 0) continue;
00595: 
00596:       const gg = Number(g);
00597:       const prev = last.get(gg);
00598: 
00599:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
00600:         last.set(gg, ts);

00602:     }
00603:   }

01446:   draws,

01448:   targetHour,
01449:   targetDow,
01450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01451: ) {

01453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);

01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {
01461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
01464: 
01465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
01467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471: 
01472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;

01483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01484:   }
01485: 
01486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
01487: }

01445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
01446:   draws,
01447:   lotteryKey,
01448:   targetHour,
01449:   targetDow,
01450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01451: ) {
01452:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01456: 
01457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01458:   let totalSamples = 0;
01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {
01461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
01464: 
01465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
01467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471: 
01472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
01474: 
01475:     totalSamples += 1;
01476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
01477:   }
01478: 
01479:   const prob = new Map();
01480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01481: 
01482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01484:   }
01485: 
01486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
01487: }

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

01589:     targetHour,
01590:     targetDow
01591:   );
01592: 
01593:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01594:   const freq = new Map();
01595:

01597:     freq.set(g, 0);
01598:   }

01600:   let totalWeight = 0;

01602:

01623:     totalWeight += weight;

01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,

01641:   };

01597:     freq.set(g, 0);
01598:   }
01599: 
01600:   let totalWeight = 0;
01601:   let matchedSamples = 0;
01602: 
01603:   for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
01604:     const target = seq[i];
01605:     const histState = [];
01606: 
01607:     for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && histState.length < 3; j -= 1) {
01608:       histState.push(Number(seq[j].grupo));
01609:     }
01610: 
01611:     const matchDepth = countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState);
01612:     if (matchDepth <= 0) continue;
01613: 
01614:     const weight =
01615:       matchDepth >= 3 ? 4.0 :
01616:       matchDepth === 2 ? 2.5 :
01617:       1.0;
01618: 
01619:     const g = Number(target.grupo);
01620:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01621: 
01622:     freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
01623:     totalWeight += weight;
01624:     matchedSamples += 1;
01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,
01639:     state: Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [],
01640:     sequenceSamples: seq.length,
01641:   };
01642: }

01644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
01645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
01646:   const groups = list
01647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
01648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
01649: 
01650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
01651:     return {
01652:       regime: "neutral",
01653:       repeatRate: 0,
01654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
01655:       samples: groups.length,
01656:     };
01657:   }
01658: 
01659:   let repeats = 0;
01660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
01661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
01662:   }
01663: 
01664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
01665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
01666: 
01667:   let regime = "neutral";
01668: 
01669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
01670:     regime = "repeat";
01671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
01672:     regime = "spread";
01673:   }
01674: 
01675:   return {
01676:     regime,
01677:     repeatRate,
01678:     uniqueRate,
01679:     samples: groups.length,
01680:   };
01681: }

01728: function computeComparableDuplicationDistribution(
01729:   draws,
01730:   lotteryKey,
01731:   targetHour,
01732:   targetDow,
01733:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01734: ) {
01735:   const list = getComparableDrawsForTargetContext(
01736:     draws,
01737:     lotteryKey,
01738:     targetHour,
01739:     targetDow
01740:   );
01741: 
01742:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01743:   const freq = new Map();
01744:   let totalSamples = 0;
01745: 
01746:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01747:     freq.set(g, 0);
01748:   }
01749: 
01750:   for (const d of list) {
01751:     const counts = countAparicoesByGrupoInDraw(d);
01752:     if (!counts.size) continue;
01753: 
01754:     totalSamples += 1;
01755: 
01756:     for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01757:       const c = Number(counts.get(g) || 0);
01758:       if (c >= 2) {
01759:         freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
01760:       }
01761:     }
01762:   }
01763: 
01764:   const prob = new Map();
01765:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01766: 
01767:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01768:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01769:   }
01770: 
01771:   return { prob, freq, totalSamples };
01772: }

01964:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01965: 
01966:       const prev = Number(last.get(g));
01967:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {

01971:   }

01976: function buildDayContext(drawsToday = []) {
01977:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(Array.isArray(drawsToday) ? drawsToday : []);
01978:   const freq = new Map();
01979:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01980:   const seq = [];
01981: 
01982:   for (const d of list) {
01983:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01984:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > 25) continue;
01985: 
01986:     const gg = Number(g);
01987:     seq.push(gg);
01988:     freq.set(gg, Number(freq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01989: 
01990:     const items = getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d);
01991:     if (items.some((it) => Number(it.grupo) === gg && Number(it.pos) === 1)) {
01992:       firstFreq.set(gg, Number(firstFreq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01993:     }
01994:   }
01995: 
01996:   const total = seq.length;
01997:   const unique = new Set(seq).size;
01998:   const diversidade = total > 0 ? unique / total : 0;
01999: 
02000:   let dominante = null;
02001:   let dominanteCount = -1;
02002:   for (const [g, n] of freq.entries()) {
02003:     if (Number(n) > dominanteCount) {
02004:       dominante = Number(g);
02005:       dominanteCount = Number(n);
02006:     }
02007:   }
02008: 
02009:   const last1 = total >= 1 ? seq[total - 1] : null;
02010:   const last2 = total >= 2 ? seq[total - 2] : null;
02011:   const repeatNow =
02012:     Number.isFinite(Number(last1)) &&
02013:     Number.isFinite(Number(last2)) &&
02014:     Number(last1) === Number(last2);
02015: 
02016:   return {
02017:     total,
02018:     unique,
02019:     diversidade,
02020:     dominante,
02021:     dominanteCount: Math.max(0, dominanteCount),
02022:     repeatNow,
02023:     freq,
02024:     firstFreq,

01977:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(Array.isArray(drawsToday) ? drawsToday : []);
01978:   const freq = new Map();
01979:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01980:   const seq = [];
01981: 
01982:   for (const d of list) {
01983:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01984:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > 25) continue;
01985: 
01986:     const gg = Number(g);
01987:     seq.push(gg);
01988:     freq.set(gg, Number(freq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01989: 
01990:     const items = getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d);
01991:     if (items.some((it) => Number(it.grupo) === gg && Number(it.pos) === 1)) {
01992:       firstFreq.set(gg, Number(firstFreq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01993:     }
01994:   }
01995: 
01996:   const total = seq.length;
01997:   const unique = new Set(seq).size;
01998:   const diversidade = total > 0 ? unique / total : 0;
01999: 
02000:   let dominante = null;
02001:   let dominanteCount = -1;
02002:   for (const [g, n] of freq.entries()) {
02003:     if (Number(n) > dominanteCount) {
02004:       dominante = Number(g);
02005:       dominanteCount = Number(n);
02006:     }
02007:   }
02008: 
02009:   const last1 = total >= 1 ? seq[total - 1] : null;
02010:   const last2 = total >= 2 ? seq[total - 2] : null;
02011:   const repeatNow =
02012:     Number.isFinite(Number(last1)) &&
02013:     Number.isFinite(Number(last2)) &&
02014:     Number(last1) === Number(last2);
02015: 
02016:   return {
02017:     total,

01951:

01953:     last.set(g, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
01954:   }

01964:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01965: 
01966:       const prev = Number(last.get(g));
01967:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
01968:         last.set(g, ts);
01969:       }
01970:     }
01971:   }
01972: 
01973:   return last;

02161:   comparableSeq,
02162:   targetTs,
02163:   windowSize = 4,
02164:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
02165: ) {
02166:   const seq = getComparableRecentDrawsBeforeTs(
02167:     Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [],
02168:     targetTs,
02169:     windowSize
02170:   );
02171: 
02172:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02173:   const counts = new Map();

02175:

02178:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
02179:     counts.set(g, Number(counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);

02191:     boost,
02192:     counts,
02193:     windowSize,
02194:     considered: Array.isArray(seq) ? seq.length : 0,
02195:   };
02196: }

02140:     const gN = Number(seq[i]?.grupo);
