02838: 
02839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
02840:   const k = Number(key);
02841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
02842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
02843: }

03437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
03438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
03439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
03440: 
03441:   const freq = new Map();
03442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
03443: 
03444:   let totalWeight = 0;
03445: 
03446:   for (const item of ranking) {
03447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
03448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
03449: 
03450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
03451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
03452: 
03453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
03454:     totalWeight += score;
03455:   }
03456: 
03457:   const prob = new Map();
03458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
03459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
03460:   }
03461: 
03462:   return {
03463:     freq,
03464:     prob,
03465:     samples: ranking.length,
03466:     totalWeight,
03467:   };
03468: }

03841:   timeline,
03842:   lotteryKey = "",
03843: }) {
03844:   const rows = Array.isArray(timeline) ? timeline : [];
03845: 
03846:   const validated = rows.filter((slot) => {
03847:     const status = String(slot?.status || "").toLowerCase();
03848:     return status === "validated" && Number.isFinite(Number(slot?.resultGrupo));
03849:   });
03850: 
03851:   const total = validated.length;
03852: 
03853:   const top1Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03854:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03855:     const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03856:     return Number.isFinite(first) && first === result;
03857:   }).length;
03858: 
03859:   const top3Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03860:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03861:     return (Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03862:       .slice(0, 3)
03863:       .some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result);
03864:   }).length;
03865: 
03866:   function pct(n, d) {
03867:     if (!d) return 0;
03868:     return Number(((Number(n || 0) / Number(d || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));
03869:   }
03870: 
03871:   function groupBy(keyFn) {
03872:     const map = new Map();
03873: 
03874:     for (const slot of validated) {
03875:       const key = keyFn(slot);
03876:       const current = map.get(key) || {
03877:         key,
03878:         total: 0,
03879:         top1Hits: 0,
03880:         top3Hits: 0,
03881:       };
03882: 
03883:       const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03884:       const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03885:       const picks = Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3.slice(0, 3) : [];
03886: 
03887:       current.total += 1;
03888:       if (Number.isFinite(first) && first === result) current.top1Hits += 1;
03889:       if (picks.some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result)) current.top3Hits += 1;
03890: 
03891:       map.set(key, current);
03892:     }
03893: 
03894:     return Array.from(map.values())
03895:       .map((x) => ({
03896:         ...x,
03897:         top1Rate: pct(x.top1Hits, x.total),
03898:         top3Rate: pct(x.top3Hits, x.total),
03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;
03903:       });
03904:   }
03905: 
03906:   return {
03907:     lotteryKey,
03908:     total,
03909:     top1Hits,
03910:     top3Hits,
03911:     top1Rate: pct(top1Hits, total),
03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),
03915:     rows: validated.map((slot) => ({
03916:       ymd: slot.targetYmd,
03917:       hour: slot.targetHour,
03918:       baseYmd: slot.baseYmd,
03919:       baseHour: slot.baseHour,
03920:       resultGrupo: slot.resultGrupo,
03921:       top3: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03922:         .slice(0, 3)
03923:         .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo)),
03924:       top1Hit:
03925:         Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo),
03926:       top3Hit: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03927:         .slice(0, 3)
03928:         .some((x) => Number(x?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo)),
03929:       historyStats: slot.historyStats || null,
03930:     })),
03931:   };
03932: }

00079: function drawTs(draw) {
00080:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00081:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00082: 
00083:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
00084: 
00085:   const [Y, M, D] = String(y).split("-").map(Number);
00086:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00087: 
00088:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00089:     return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
00090:   }
00091: 
00092:   return Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D) + mins * 60 * 1000;
00093: }

00104: function clampColsFromItemMilharesCols(milharesCols, expectedCols = 4, perCol = 5) {
00105:   const colsArr = Array.isArray(milharesCols) ? milharesCols : [];
00106:   const out = [];

00115:       .slice(0, perCol);

00128: function build20ByDezena({ grupo, baseMilhares, perCol = 5 }) {
00129:   const g = Number(grupo);
00130:   const dezenas = getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(g);
00131: 
00132:   if (!dezenas.length) {
00133:     return { dezenas: [], rows: [], flat20: [] };
00134:   }
00135: 
00136:   const input = Array.isArray(baseMilhares) ? baseMilhares : [];
00137:   const normalized = input
00138:     .map(normalizeMilharStr)
00139:     .filter((x) => /^\d{4}$/.test(x));
00140: 
00141:   const byDz = new Map();
00142:   for (const dz of dezenas) byDz.set(dz, []);
00143: 
00144:   for (const m4 of normalized) {
00145:     const dz = dezenaFromMilhar(m4);
00146:     if (byDz.has(dz)) byDz.get(dz).push(m4);
00147:   }
00148: 
00149:   const seenCent = new Set();
00150:   const seenMilhar = new Set();
00151: 
00152:   const cols = {};
00153:   for (const dz of dezenas) cols[dz] = [];
00154: 
00155:   const tryPush = (dz, m4) => {
00156:     const mm = normalizeMilharStr(m4);
00157:     if (!mm) return false;
00158: 
00159:     const c3 = centenaFromMilhar(mm);
00160:     if (!c3) return false;
00161: 
00162:     if (seenCent.has(c3)) return false;
00163:     if (seenMilhar.has(mm)) return false;
00164: 
00165:     cols[dz].push(mm);
00166:     seenCent.add(c3);
00167:     seenMilhar.add(mm);
00168:     return true;
00169:   };
00170: 
00171:   for (const dz of dezenas) {
00172:     const arr = byDz.get(dz) || [];
00173:     for (const m4 of arr) {
00174:       if (cols[dz].length >= perCol) break;
00175:       tryPush(dz, m4);
00176:     }
00177:   }
00178: 
00179:   for (const dz of dezenas) {
00180:     while (cols[dz].length < perCol) cols[dz].push("");
00181:     if (cols[dz].length > perCol) cols[dz] = cols[dz].slice(0, perCol);
00182:   }
00183: 
00184:   const rows = [];
00185:   for (let r = 0; r < perCol; r += 1) {
00186:     rows.push(dezenas.map((dz) => cols[dz][r] || ""));
00187:   }
00188: 
00189:   const flat20 = rows.flat().filter(Boolean);
00190:   return { dezenas, rows, flat20 };
00191: }

00128: function build20ByDezena({ grupo, baseMilhares, perCol = 5 }) {
00129:   const g = Number(grupo);
00130:   const dezenas = getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(g);
00131: 
00132:   if (!dezenas.length) {
00133:     return { dezenas: [], rows: [], flat20: [] };
00134:   }
00135: 
00136:   const input = Array.isArray(baseMilhares) ? baseMilhares : [];
00137:   const normalized = input
00138:     .map(normalizeMilharStr)
00139:     .filter((x) => /^\d{4}$/.test(x));
00140: 
00141:   const byDz = new Map();
00142:   for (const dz of dezenas) byDz.set(dz, []);
00143: 
00144:   for (const m4 of normalized) {
00145:     const dz = dezenaFromMilhar(m4);
00146:     if (byDz.has(dz)) byDz.get(dz).push(m4);
00147:   }
00148: 
00149:   const seenCent = new Set();
00150:   const seenMilhar = new Set();
00151: 
00152:   const cols = {};
00153:   for (const dz of dezenas) cols[dz] = [];
00154: 
00155:   const tryPush = (dz, m4) => {
00156:     const mm = normalizeMilharStr(m4);
00157:     if (!mm) return false;
00158: 
00159:     const c3 = centenaFromMilhar(mm);
00160:     if (!c3) return false;
00161: 
00162:     if (seenCent.has(c3)) return false;
00163:     if (seenMilhar.has(mm)) return false;
00164:

00166:     seenCent.add(c3);
00167:     seenMilhar.add(mm);
00168:     return true;

00172:     const arr = byDz.get(dz) || [];

00174:       if (cols[dz].length >= perCol) break;
00175:       tryPush(dz, m4);
00176:     }
00177:   }
00178: 
00179:   for (const dz of dezenas) {
00180:     while (cols[dz].length < perCol) cols[dz].push("");
00181:     if (cols[dz].length > perCol) cols[dz] = cols[dz].slice(0, perCol);
00182:   }
00183: 
00184:   const rows = [];
00185:   for (let r = 0; r < perCol; r += 1) {
00186:     rows.push(dezenas.map((dz) => cols[dz][r] || ""));
00187:   }
00188: 
00189:   const flat20 = rows.flat().filter(Boolean);
00190:   return { dezenas, rows, flat20 };
00191: }

00082: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00083:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00084:   if (!s) return null;
00085: 
00086:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00087:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00088: 
00089:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00090:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00091: 
00092:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00093:   if (m3) {
00094:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00095:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00096:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00097:   }
00098: 
00099:   return s;
00100: }

00105: function isValidHHMM(value) {
00106:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();

00114:     Number.isFinite(mm) &&

00118:     mm <= 59

00001: export const CACHE_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 min
00002: 
00003: export function cacheGet(map, key) {
00004:   const entry = map.get(key);
00005:   if (!entry) return null;
00006: 
00007:   const ts = Number(entry?.ts || 0);
00008:   if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || Date.now() - ts > CACHE_TTL_MS) {
00009:     map.delete(key);
00010:     return null;
00011:   }
00012: 
00013:   return entry.data ?? null;
00014: }
00015: 
00016: export function cacheSet(map, key, data) {
00017:   map.set(key, { ts: Date.now(), data });
00018: }

00264: function resolveHourFilter({ closeHour = null, closeHourBucket = null }) {
00265:   const bucket = toHourBucket(closeHourBucket);
00266:   if (bucket) return { kind: "bucket", bucket, hhmm: null };
00267: 
00268:   const hhmm = closeHour ? normalizeHourLike(closeHour) : null;
00269:   if (hhmm) return { kind: "exact", bucket: null, hhmm };
00270: 
00271:   return { kind: null, bucket: null, hhmm: null };
00272: }

00274: function drawPassesHourFilter(draw, hourFilter) {
00275:   if (!hourFilter || !hourFilter.kind) return true;
00276: 
00277:   const raw =
00278:     draw?.close_hour ?? draw?.closeHour ?? draw?.hour ?? draw?.hora ?? "";
00279:   const norm = normalizeHourLike(raw);
00280: 
00281:   if (hourFilter.kind === "exact") {
00282:     return norm === normalizeHourLike(hourFilter.hhmm);
00283:   }
00284: 
00285:   if (hourFilter.kind === "bucket") {
00286:     return toHourBucket(norm) === toHourBucket(hourFilter.bucket);
00287:   }
00288: 
00289:   return true;
00290: }

00383: function dedupeDrawsLocal(draws) {
00384:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00385: 
00386:   const byKey = new Map();
00387:   const order = [];
00388: 
00389:   function score(d) {
00390:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00391:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
00392:       ? Number(d.prizesCount)
00393:       : 0;
00394:     const hasLogical = !!(d?.ymd && d?.close_hour);
00395:     return prizesLen * 1_000_000 + pc * 1_000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00396:   }
00397: 
00398:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00399:     const raw = arr[i] || {};

00402:     const hour = normalizeHourLike(raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "");
00403: 
00404:     const lotCode = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(raw);
00405: 
00406:     const drawId = raw.drawId ?? raw.id ?? raw.__name__ ?? null;
00407:     const idStr = drawId != null ? String(drawId) : "";
00408: 
00409:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hour);
00410: 
00411:     const key = hasLogical
00412:       ? lotCode
00413:         ? `${ymd}__${hour}__${lotCode}`
00414:         : `${ymd}__${hour}`
00415:       : `id__${idStr || `idx_${i}`}`;
00416: 
00417:     const normalized = {
00418:       ...raw,
00419:       ymd: ymd || raw.ymd || null,
00420:       close_hour: hour || raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "",
00421:       closeHour: hour || raw.closeHour || raw.close_hour || "",
00422:       lottery_code: lotCode || raw.lottery_code || raw.lotteryCode || null,
00423:       drawId: raw.drawId || raw.id || raw.__name__ || null,
00424:       id: raw.id || raw.drawId || raw.__name__ || null,
00425:     };
00426: 
00427:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00428:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00429:       order.push(key);
00430:       continue;
00431:     }
00432: 
00433:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00434:     if (score(normalized) > score(prev)) {
00435:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00436:     }
00437:   }
00438: 
00439:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);

01004: function buildPrizeSignature(draw) {
01005:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
01006:   if (!prizes.length) return "";
01007: 
01008:   const parts = prizes
01009:     .map((p) => {
01010:       const pos = Number(p?.position);
01011:       const grupo = Number(p?.grupo);
01012:       const numero = toPrizeDigitsByPosition(
01013:         p?.numero ?? p?.milhar ?? p?.number ?? p?.num ?? p?.valor ?? "",
01014:         pos
01015:       );
01016: 
01017:       if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || !Number.isFinite(grupo) || !numero) return "";
01018:       return `${pad2(pos)}:${pad2(grupo)}:${numero}`;
01019:     })
01020:     .filter(Boolean)
01021:     .sort();
01022: 
01023:   return parts.join("|");
01024: }

01026: function federalHourPriority(draw) {
01027:   const h = normalizeHourLike(
01028:     draw?.close_hour || draw?.closeHour || draw?.hour || draw?.hora || ""
01029:   );
01030:   const ymd = String(draw?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(draw?.date) || "").trim();
01031:   const n = hourToNumSafe(h);
01032: 
01033:   const prefer20h = getFederalPreferredHourForYmd(ymd) === "20:00";
01034: 
01035:   if (prefer20h) {
01036:     if (h === "20:00") return 200000 + n;
01037:     if (h === "19:00") return 190000 + n;
01038:     return 100000 + n;
01039:   }
01040: 
01041:   if (h === "19:00") return 200000 + n;
01042:   if (h === "20:00") return 190000 + n;
01043:   return 100000 + n;
01044: }

01046: function pickBetterFederalClone(a, b) {
01047:   const pa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.prizesCount))
01048:     ? Number(a.prizesCount)
01049:     : Array.isArray(a?.prizes)
01050:     ? a.prizes.length
01051:     : 0;
01052: 
01053:   const pb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.prizesCount))
01054:     ? Number(b.prizesCount)
01055:     : Array.isArray(b?.prizes)
01056:     ? b.prizes.length
01057:     : 0;
01058: 
01059:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
01060: 
01061:   const ha = federalHourPriority(a);
01062:   const hb = federalHourPriority(b);
01063:   if (ha !== hb) return hb > ha ? b : a;
01064: 
01065:   const ia = String(a?.drawId || a?.id || "");
01066:   const ib = String(b?.drawId || b?.id || "");
01067:   return ib.localeCompare(ia) > 0 ? b : a;
01068: }

01070: function collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(draws) {
01071:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01072:   const byKey = new Map();
01073: 
01074:   for (const d of arr) {
01075:     const ymd = String(d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date) || "").trim();
01076:     const sig = buildPrizeSignature(d);
01077: 
01078:     if (!ymd || !sig) {
01079:       const fallbackKey = `id::${String(
01080:         d?.drawId || d?.id || Math.random()
01081:       )}`;
01082:       if (!byKey.has(fallbackKey)) byKey.set(fallbackKey, d);
01083:       continue;
01084:     }
01085: 
01086:     const key = `${ymd}__${sig}`;
01087:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
01088: 
01089:     if (!prev) byKey.set(key, d);
01090:     else byKey.set(key, pickBetterFederalClone(prev, d));
01091:   }
01092: 
01093:   return sortDrawsLocal(Array.from(byKey.values()));
01094: }

00253: function addDaysYMD(ymd, deltaDays) {
00254:   if (!isYMD(ymd)) return ymd;
00255:   const [Y, M, D] = ymd.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00256:   const dt = new Date(Y, M - 1, D);
00257:   dt.setDate(dt.getDate() + Number(deltaDays || 0));
00258:   return `${dt.getFullYear()}-${pad2(dt.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(dt.getDate())}`;
00259: }

00261: function prevHourFromSchedule(schedule, targetHour) {
00262:   const sch = Array.isArray(schedule) && schedule.length ? schedule : [];
00263:   const t = toHourBucket(targetHour);
00264:   const idx = sch.findIndex((h) => toHourBucket(h) === t);
00265:   if (idx < 0) return null;
00266:   if (idx > 0) return sch[idx - 1];
00267:   return null;
00268: }

00012: /**
00013:  * Normaliza qualquer formato de grupo para "01".."25".
00014:  * Aceita:
00015:  * - 7, "7", "07"
00016:  * - "Grupo 7", "GRUPO 07", "G7", "G-07"
00017:  * - "25 - VACA", "grupo:25"
00018:  *
00019:  * Retorna "00" se inválido.
00020:  */
00021: function normalizeGrupo(g) {
00022:   const s0 = String(g ?? "").trim();
00023:   if (!s0) return "00";
00024: 
00025:   // 1) se já vier exatamente "07"
00026:   if (/^\d{2}$/.test(s0)) {
00027:     const n = Number(s0);
00028:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00029:     return pad2(n);
00030:   }
00031: 
00032:   // 2) se vier "7"
00033:   if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(s0)) {
00034:     const n = Number(s0);
00035:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00036:     return pad2(n);
00037:   }
00038: 
00039:   // 3) extrai 1-2 dígitos de dentro do texto (ex.: "Grupo 25", "25 - VACA")
00040:   const m = s0.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00041:   if (m) {
00042:     const n = Number(m[1]);
00043:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00044:     return pad2(n);
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   return "00";
00048: }

00050: export function validateRankingLineByLine(expectedCounts, rankingRows) {
00051:   const issues = [];
00052:   const gotMap = new Map();
00053: 
00054:   const ignoredExpectedKeys = [];
00055:   const ignoredRows = [];
00056: 
00057:   // expectedCounts normalizado
00058:   const expectedNorm = {};
00059:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(expectedCounts || {})) {
00060:     const g = normalizeGrupo(k);
00061:     if (g === "00") {
00062:       ignoredExpectedKeys.push(String(k));
00063:       continue;
00064:     }
00065:     expectedNorm[g] = toNumber(v);
00066:   }
00067: 
00068:   // soma rows por grupo
00069:   for (const r of rankingRows || []) {
00070:     const rawG = r?.grupo ?? r?.group;
00071:     const g = normalizeGrupo(rawG);
00072:     if (g === "00") {
00073:       ignoredRows.push({ rawGrupo: rawG, row: r });
00074:       continue;
00075:     }
00076: 
00077:     const val = toNumber(r?.apar ?? r?.total ?? r?.count ?? r?.value ?? 0);
00078:     gotMap.set(g, toNumber(gotMap.get(g)) + val);
00079:   }
00080: 
00081:   const allGroups = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => pad2(i + 1));
00082: 
00083:   let okCount = 0;
00084:   let diffCount = 0;
00085: 
00086:   for (const g of allGroups) {
00087:     const expected = toNumber(expectedNorm?.[g] ?? 0);
00088:     const got = toNumber(gotMap.get(g) ?? 0);
00089:     const delta = got - expected;
00090: 
00091:     const status = delta === 0 ? "OK" : "DIF";
00092:     if (status === "OK") okCount += 1;
00093:     else diffCount += 1;
00094: 
00095:     issues.push({ grupo: g, esperado: expected, obtido: got, delta, status });
00096:   }
00097: 
00098:   const totalEsperado = allGroups.reduce(
00099:     (acc, g) => acc + toNumber(expectedNorm?.[g] ?? 0),
00100:     0
00101:   );
00102: 
00103:   const totalObtido = Array.from(gotMap.values()).reduce(
00104:     (acc, v) => acc + toNumber(v),
00105:     0
00106:   );
00107: 
00108:   const gotMapObj = {};
00109:   for (const g of allGroups) gotMapObj[g] = toNumber(gotMap.get(g) ?? 0);
00110: 
00111:   return {
00112:     issues,
00113:     okCount,
00114:     diffCount,
00115:     totalEsperado,
00116:     totalObtido,
00117:     totalDelta: totalObtido - totalEsperado,
00118:     gotMapObj,
00119: 
00120:     // extras p/ debug
00121:     ignoredExpectedKeys,
00122:     ignoredRowsCount: ignoredRows.length,
00123:   };
00124: }

00040:   const m = s0.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00041:   if (m) {
00042:     const n = Number(m[1]);
00043:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";

00320: /**
00321:  * buildPalpite (V1)
00322:  *
00323:  * opts:
00324:  * - closeHourBucket: "09h" | "11h" | etc
00325:  * - minDraws: default 400
00326:  * - maxDraws: default 2000
00327:  */
00328: export function buildPalpite(draws, opts = {}) {
00329:   const closeHourBucket = opts.closeHourBucket ? String(opts.closeHourBucket).trim() : null;
00330: 
00331:   const minDraws = Number.isFinite(+opts.minDraws) ? Math.max(1, +opts.minDraws) : 400;
00332:   const maxDraws = Number.isFinite(+opts.maxDraws) ? Math.max(minDraws, +opts.maxDraws) : 2000;
00333: 
00334:   let base = dedupeDraws(draws);
00335: 
00336:   if (closeHourBucket) {
00337:     base = base.filter((d) => toHourBucketLabel(getDrawCloseHour(d)) === closeHourBucket);
00338:   }
00339: 
00340:   const ordered = sortDrawsChrono(base);
00341: 
00342:   const total = ordered.length;
00343:   const windowed = total > maxDraws ? ordered.slice(total - maxDraws) : ordered;
00344: 
00345:   const perGrupo = new Map();
00346: 
00347:   const ensure = (g) => {
00348:     if (!perGrupo.has(g)) {
00349:       perGrupo.set(g, { dez: new Map(), cent: new Map(), milhar: new Map() });
00350:     }
00351:     return perGrupo.get(g);
00352:   };
00353: 
00354:   let seq = 0;
00355:   for (const d of windowed) {
00356:     seq += 1;
00357:     for (const p of d?.prizes || []) {
00358:       const g = getGrupoNumFromPrize(p);
00359:       if (!g) continue;
00360: 
00361:       const milhar = extractMilharFromPrize(p);
00362:       if (!milhar) continue;
00363: 
00364:       const holder = ensure(pad2(g));
00365:       const dez = milhar.slice(-2);
00366:       const cent = milhar.slice(-3);
00367: 
00368:       for (const [map, key] of [
00369:         [holder.dez, dez],
00370:         [holder.cent, cent],

00284: /**
00285:  * ✅ V2: desempate por ANTIGUIDADE
00286:  * - Maior frequência vence
00287:  * - Empate: menor firstSeen vence (mais antigo)
00288:  */
00289: function pickTopByFreqAndOldest(freqMap) {
00290:   let bestKey = null;
00291:   let bestCount = -1;
00292:   let bestFirst = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00293: 
00294:   for (const [k, v] of freqMap.entries()) {
00295:     const c = Number(v?.count || 0);
00296:     const first = Number(v?.firstSeen ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
00297: 
00298:     if (c > bestCount || (c === bestCount && first < bestFirst)) {
00299:       bestKey = k;
00300:       bestCount = c;
00301:       bestFirst = first;
00302:     }
00303:   }
00304: 
00305:   return bestKey;
00306: }

00453:     return perGrupo.get(g);
00454:   };
00455: 
00456:   // seq = índice cronológico (1..N) para medir "primeira aparição"
00457:   let seq = 0;
00458: 
00459:   for (const d of ordered) {
00460:     seq += 1;
00461: 
00462:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00463:     for (const p of prizes) {
00464:       const gNum = getGrupoNumFromPrize(p);
00465:       if (!gNum) continue;
00466: 
00467:       const milhar = extractMilharFromPrize(p);
00468:       if (!milhar) continue;
00469: 
00470:       const dez = milhar.slice(-2);
00471:       const centDigit = milhar.slice(-3, -2); // unidade de centena
00472:       const milDigit = milhar.slice(-4, -3); // unidade de milhar
00473: 
00474:       const holder = ensure(pad2(gNum));
00475: 
00476:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.dez, dez, seq);
00477:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.centDigit, centDigit, seq);
00478:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.milDigit, milDigit, seq);
00479:     }
00480:   }
00481: 
00482:   const palpitesByGrupo = {};
00483:   const debugByGrupo = {};
00484: 
00485:   for (let i = 1; i <= 25; i++) {
00486:     const g = pad2(i);
00487:     const h = perGrupo.get(g);
00488: 
00489:     if (!h || h.dez.size === 0) {
00490:       palpitesByGrupo[g] = null;
00491:       debugByGrupo[g] = { reason: "no_numbers_in_slice" };
00492:       continue;
00493:     }
00494: 
00495:     const dezWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.dez);
00496:     const centDigitWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.centDigit);
00497:     const milDigitWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.milDigit);
00498: 
00499:     if (!dezWin || centDigitWin == null || milDigitWin == null) {
00500:       palpitesByGrupo[g] = null;
00501:       debugByGrupo[g] = {
00502:         reason: "incomplete_components",
00503:         dezWin,
00504:         centDigitWin,
00505:         milDigitWin,
00506:       };
00507:       continue;
00508:     }
00509: 
00510:     const palpite = `${String(milDigitWin)}${String(centDigitWin)}${String(dezWin)}`.padStart(
00511:       4,
00512:       "0"
00513:     );
00514: 
00515:     palpitesByGrupo[g] = palpite;
00516:     debugByGrupo[g] = { dezWin, centDigitWin, milDigitWin };
00517:   }
00518: 
00519:   return {
00520:     palpitesByGrupo,
00521:     sampleDrawsUsed: ordered.length,
00522:     totalCandidates: ordered.length,
00523:     usedBucket: closeHourBucket || null,
00524:     debugByGrupo,
00525:   };
00526: }

00140: function dedupeDraws(draws) {
00141:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00142:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00143: 
00144:   const seen = new Set();
00145:   const out = [];
00146: 
00147:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00148:     const d = arr[i];
00149: 
00150:     const ymd =
00151:       String(d?.ymd || "").trim() ||
00152:       normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d)) ||
00153:       "";
00154: 
00155:     const hour = getDrawHourRaw(d);
00156: 
00157:     const logicalKey = ymd && hour ? `${ymd}__${hour}` : "";
00158:     const fallbackKey =
00159:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00160:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00161:       "";
00162: 
00163:     const key = logicalKey || fallbackKey || `${ymd || "nodate"}__${hour || "nohour"}__idx${i}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00166:     seen.add(key);
00167:     out.push(d);
00168:   }
00169: 
00170:   return out;
00171: }

00178:  */
00179: function dedupePrizes(prizes) {

00181:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00182: 
00183:   const seen = new Set();
00184:   const out = [];

00187:     const p = arr[i];
00188: 
00189:     const grupoRaw = p?.grupo ?? p?.group ?? "";
00190:     const animalRaw = p?.animal ?? "";
00191:     const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? "";
00192: 
00193:     const baseFallback = `${String(posRaw)}__${String(grupoRaw)}__${normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw)}`;
00194:     const key =
00195:       (p?.prizeId != null && String(p.prizeId)) ||
00196:       (String(posRaw).trim() ? baseFallback : `${baseFallback}__idx${i}`);
00197: 
00198:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00199:     seen.add(key);
00200:     out.push(p);
00201:   }
00202: 
00203:   return out;
